sentences.zh: 求經朔弦望入轉

translations.literal: To find mean new moon, quarters, and full moon entry into revolution.
translations.idiomatic: To find mean new moon, quarters, and full moon entry into revolution.

sentences.zh: 置天正朔積分，以轉終分及秒去之，不盡，如日法而一，為日，不滿為餘秒，即天正十一月經朔入轉日及餘秒。

translations.literal: Set the celestial-standard new-moon accumulated parts; remove full revolution terminator parts and seconds; what remains, divide by one as the day divisor for days, what does not fill is remainder-seconds—that is the celestial-standard eleventh month mean new moon's entry-into-revolution day and remainder-seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Set the celestial-standard new-moon accumulated parts; cast out full revolution terminator parts and seconds; divide the remainder by the day divisor for days, with the unfilled portion as remainder-seconds—that yields the celestial-standard eleventh month mean new moon's day and remainder-seconds of entry into revolution.

sentences.zh: 以象策累加之，去命如前，即得弦、望經日加時入轉日及餘秒。

translations.literal: Add the phase stride cumulatively; remove and name as before—then obtain quarters and full moon mean day-and-hour entry-into-revolution day and remainder-seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Add the phase stride cumulatively; cast out and name as before—to obtain each quarter and full moon mean day-and-hour entry into revolution with its day and remainder-seconds.

sentences.zh: 徑求次朔入轉。

translations.literal: To find directly the next new moon's entry into revolution.
translations.idiomatic: To find directly the next new moon's entry into revolution.

sentences.zh: 以朔差加之。

translations.literal: Add the new-moon difference.
translations.idiomatic: Add the new-moon difference.

sentences.zh: 轉定分及積度朓棵率

translations.literal: Revolution fixed parts and accumulated-degree tiao–chuo rates.
translations.idiomatic: Revolution fixed parts and accumulated-degree tiao–chuo rates.

sentences.zh: 求朔弦望入轉朓棵定數

translations.literal: To find new moon, quarters, and full moon entry-into-revolution tiao–chuo fixed number.
translations.idiomatic: To find the entry-into-revolution tiao–chuo fixed number for new moon, quarters, and full moon.

sentences.zh: 置入轉小餘，以其日算外，損益率乘之，如日法而一，所得，以損益積為定數。

translations.literal: Set the entry-into-revolution minor remainder; outside the count for that day, multiply by the deficit–surplus rate, divide by one as the day divisor, and with what is obtained add or subtract the accumulation for the fixed number.
translations.idiomatic: Set the entry-into-revolution minor remainder; beyond the count for that day, multiply by the deficit–surplus rate and divide by the day divisor; apply the result to the accumulation to obtain the fixed number.

sentences.zh: 其四七日下余，如初數以下，初率乘之，初數而一，以損益朓棵積為定數。

translations.literal: For the four and seven days below in remainder: if below the initial count, multiply by the initial rate and divide by the initial count, and with that add or subtract the tiao–chuo accumulation for the fixed number.
translations.idiomatic: On the fourth and seventh days and below in remainder: if below the initial count, multiply by the initial rate, divide by the initial count, and apply the result to the tiao–chuo accumulation for the fixed number.

sentences.zh: 如初數以上，初數減之，餘乘末率，末數而一，便為朓棵定數。

translations.literal: If at or above the initial count, subtract the initial count; multiply the remainder by the final rate and divide by the final count—that is then the tiao–chuo fixed number.
translations.idiomatic: If at or above the initial count, subtract the initial count; multiply the remainder by the final rate and divide by the final count—that yields the tiao–chuo fixed number.

sentences.zh: 求朔弦望定日

translations.literal: To find fixed new moon, quarters, and full moon days.
translations.idiomatic: To find fixed new moon, quarters, and full moon days.

sentences.zh: 置經朔、弦、望小餘，朓減朒加入氣入轉朓棵定數，滿與不足，進退大餘，命甲子算外，各得定朔、弦、望日辰及餘。

translations.literal: Set the mean new moon, quarter, and full moon minor remainders; subtract tiao and add chuo, add the entry-into-qi and entry-into-revolution tiao–chuo fixed number; on fullness or shortfall, advance or retreat the major remainder; name outside jiazi—each yields the fixed new moon, quarter, and full moon day, double-hour, and remainder.
translations.idiomatic: Set the mean new moon, quarter, and full moon minor remainders; subtract tiao and add chuo, then add the entry-into-qi and entry-into-revolution tiao–chuo fixed number; on fullness or shortfall, advance or retreat the major remainder and name outside jiazi—thus each fixed new moon, quarter, and full moon with its day, double-hour, and remainder.

sentences.zh: 定朔前幹名與後幹名同者，其月大；

translations.literal: When the stem before the fixed new moon and the stem after are the same, the month is long;
translations.idiomatic: When the stem before the fixed new moon matches the stem after, the month is long;

sentences.zh: 不同者，其月小。

translations.literal: when they differ, the month is short.
translations.idiomatic: when they differ, the month is short.

sentences.zh: 月內無中氣者為閏。

translations.literal: A month with no mid-qi within it is intercalary.
translations.idiomatic: A month with no mid-qi within it is intercalary.

sentences.zh: 視定朔小餘：秋分後，在日法四分之三以上者，進一日。

translations.literal: Inspect the fixed new moon minor remainder: after the autumn equinox, if at three-quarters of the day divisor or above, advance one day.
translations.idiomatic: Inspect the fixed new moon minor remainder: after the autumn equinox, if it reaches three-quarters of the day divisor or above, advance one day.

sentences.zh: 春分後，定朔日出分與春分日出分相減之餘，三約之，用減四分之三，定朔小餘及此數以上者，亦進一日。

translations.literal: After the spring equinox, take the remainder from subtracting the spring-equinox sunrise fraction from the fixed-new-moon sunrise fraction, reduce by three, use it to subtract from three-quarters; if the fixed new moon minor remainder reaches this number or above, also advance one day.
translations.idiomatic: After the spring equinox, subtract the spring-equinox sunrise fraction from the fixed-new-moon sunrise fraction, divide the remainder by three, subtract that from three-quarters of the day divisor; if the fixed new moon minor remainder reaches this threshold or above, advance one day as well.

sentences.zh: 或有交，虧初在日入前者，不進之。

translations.literal: If there is a crossing and the eclipse begins before sunset, do not advance.
translations.idiomatic: If there is a crossing and first contact comes before sunset, do not advance.

sentences.zh: 定弦、望小餘在日出分以下者，退一日。

translations.literal: When the fixed quarter or full moon minor remainder falls below the sunrise fraction, retreat one day.
translations.idiomatic: When the fixed quarter or full moon minor remainder falls below the sunrise fraction, retreat one day.

sentences.zh: 望或有交，虧初在日出前者，小餘雖在日出後，亦退之。

translations.literal: At full moon, if there is a crossing and first contact comes before sunrise, even though the minor remainder is after sunrise, still retreat.
translations.idiomatic: At full moon, if there is a crossing and first contact comes before sunrise, retreat even when the minor remainder lies after sunrise.

sentences.zh: 如十七日望者，又視定朔小餘在四分之三以下之數，春分後用減定之數。

translations.literal: For a full moon on the seventeenth day, also inspect whether the fixed new moon minor remainder lies at or below three-quarters; after the spring equinox use the subtracted fixed number.
translations.idiomatic: For a seventeenth-day full moon, also inspect whether the fixed new moon minor remainder lies at or below three-quarters; after the spring equinox apply the subtracted fixed number.

sentences.zh: 與定望小餘在日出分以上之數相較之；

translations.literal: Compare it with the fixed full moon minor remainder at or above the sunrise fraction;
translations.idiomatic: Compare it with the fixed full moon minor remainder at or above the sunrise fraction;

sentences.zh: 朔少望多者，望不退，而朔猶進之。

translations.literal: if the new moon is less and the full moon greater, do not retreat the full moon but still advance the new moon.
translations.idiomatic: if the new moon is less and the full moon greater, do not retreat the full moon but still advance the new moon.

sentences.zh: 望少朔多者，朔不進，而望猶退之。

translations.literal: if the full moon is less and the new moon greater, do not advance the new moon but still retreat the full moon.
translations.idiomatic: if the full moon is less and the new moon greater, do not advance the new moon but still retreat the full moon.

sentences.zh: 日月之行，有盈有縮，遲疾加減之數，或有四大三小；

translations.literal: Sun and moon in their courses have expansion and contraction, and numbers for slow and fast addition and subtraction—sometimes four long months and three short;
translations.idiomatic: Sun and moon in their courses swell and shrink, with slow-and-fast corrections—and sometimes four long months and three short;

sentences.zh: 若隨常理，當察其時早晚，隨所近而進退之，使不過三大二小。

translations.literal: if one follows ordinary principle, one should inspect whether the time is early or late and advance or retreat according to what is nearer, so as not to exceed three long and two short.
translations.idiomatic: by ordinary rule one should weigh whether the season runs early or late and advance or retreat toward the nearer case, keeping the count within three long and two short months.

sentences.zh: 求定朔弦望中積

translations.literal: To find the fixed new moon, quarter, and full moon middle accumulations.
translations.idiomatic: To find the fixed new moon, quarter, and full moon middle accumulations.

sentences.zh: 置定朔、弦、望大小餘與經朔、弦、望大小餘相減之餘，以加減經朔、弦、望入氣日餘，經朔、弦、望少即加之，多即減之。

translations.literal: Set the remainder from subtracting the fixed new moon, quarter, and full moon major and minor remainders from the mean new moon, quarter, and full moon major and minor remainders, and with it add or subtract the mean new moon, quarter, and full moon entry-into-qi day remainders—if the mean is less, add; if more, subtract.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract each mean new moon, quarter, and full moon major and minor remainder from its fixed counterpart; use the difference to add or subtract the mean entry-into-qi day remainders—add when the mean is less, subtract when greater.

sentences.zh: 即為定朔、弦、望入氣。

translations.literal: That is then the fixed new moon, quarter, and full moon entry into qi.
translations.idiomatic: That yields each fixed new moon, quarter, and full moon entry into qi.

sentences.zh: 以加其氣中積，即為定朔、弦、望中積。

translations.literal: Add it to the qi middle accumulation—that is then the fixed new moon, quarter, and full moon middle accumulation.
translations.idiomatic: Add this to the qi middle accumulation—that yields each fixed new moon, quarter, and full moon middle accumulation.

sentences.zh: 其餘以日法退除為分秒。

translations.literal: The remainder is reduced by the day divisor to obtain fen and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Reduce the remainder by the day divisor to obtain parts and seconds.

sentences.zh: 求定朔弦望加時日度

translations.literal: To find the solar degree at the added time of fixed new moon, quarters, and full moon.
translations.idiomatic: To find the solar degree at the time of fixed new moon, first and last quarter, and full moon.

sentences.zh: 置定朔、弦、望約餘，以所入氣日損益率乘，盈縮損益。

translations.literal: Set the fixed new moon, quarter, and full moon reduced remainders; multiply by the daily gain-and-loss rate of the qi entered; apply excess-and-deficit adjustment.
translations.idiomatic: Set the fixed new moon, quarter, and full moon reduced remainders, multiply by the entered qi's daily gain-and-loss rate, and apply excess-and-deficit adjustment.

sentences.zh: 萬約之，以損益其下盈縮積，乃盈加縮減定朔弦望中積；

translations.literal: Reduce by 10,000; use it to adjust the excess-and-deficit accumulation below; then excess adds and deficit subtracts the fixed new moon, quarter, and full moon mean accumulation;
translations.idiomatic: Reduce by 10,000, adjust the excess-and-deficit accumulation below, then by excess add and deficit subtract the fixed new moon, quarter, and full moon mean accumulation;

sentences.zh: 又以冬至加時日躔黃道宿度加之，依宿次去之，即得定朔、弦、望加時日所在度及分秒。

translations.literal: also add the winter solstice time-of-occurrence solar motion along the ecliptic lodge degree; remove by lodge sequence, and you obtain the degree and parts-seconds of the sun's place at the fixed new moon, quarter, and full moon added times.
translations.idiomatic: add the winter solstice time-of-occurrence ecliptic solar lodge degree and remove by lodge sequence to obtain the sun's degree and parts-seconds at the fixed new moon, quarter, and full moon times.

sentences.zh: 又置定朔、弦、望約餘，副置之。

translations.literal: Again set the fixed new moon, quarter, and full moon reduced remainders and place a duplicate.
translations.idiomatic: Again set the fixed new moon, quarter, and full moon reduced remainders and place a duplicate aside.

sentences.zh: 以乘其日盈縮之損益率，萬約之，應益者盈加縮減，應損者盈減縮加其副，滿百為分，分滿百為度，以加其日夜半日度，命之，各得其日加時日躔黃道宿次。

translations.literal: Multiply by that day's excess-and-deficit gain-and-loss rate, reduce by 10,000; where it should gain, excess adds and deficit subtracts; where it should lose, excess subtracts and deficit adds to the duplicate; when parts fill 100 make fen, when fen fill 100 make degrees, add to that day's midnight solar degree and name it—each day's added-time solar motion along the ecliptic lodge is obtained.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply by that day's excess-and-deficit gain-and-loss rate and reduce by 10,000; where gain is due, excess adds and deficit subtracts; where loss is due, excess subtracts and deficit adds to the duplicate; when parts fill 100 make fen, when fen fill 100 make degrees, add to that day's midnight solar degree and name it—thus each day's added-time ecliptic solar lodge is found.

sentences.zh: 若先於曆註定每日夜半日度，即為妙也。

translations.literal: If each day's midnight solar degree has already been entered in the calendar, that is best.
translations.idiomatic: If each day's midnight solar degree is already recorded in the calendar, so much the better.

sentences.zh: 求定朔弦望加時月度

translations.literal: To find the lunar degree at the added time of fixed new moon, quarters, and full moon.
translations.idiomatic: To find the lunar degree at the time of fixed new moon, first and last quarter, and full moon.

sentences.zh: 凡合朔加時日月同度，其定朔加時黃道日度，即為定朔加時黃道月度。

translations.literal: Whenever at conjunction the sun and moon share the same degree, the fixed new moon added-time ecliptic solar degree is the fixed new moon added-time ecliptic lunar degree.
translations.idiomatic: At conjunction the sun and moon share the same degree; the fixed new moon time-of-occurrence ecliptic solar degree is the fixed new moon time-of-occurrence ecliptic lunar degree.

sentences.zh: 弦、望各以弦、望度加定弦、望加時黃道日度，依宿次去之，即得定朔、弦、望加時黃道月度及分秒。

translations.literal: For quarters and full moon, each add the quarter or full moon arc to the fixed quarter or full moon added-time ecliptic solar degree; remove by lodge sequence, and you obtain the fixed new moon, quarter, and full moon added-time ecliptic lunar degree and parts-seconds.
translations.idiomatic: For first and last quarter and full moon, add the quarter or full moon arc to the fixed added-time ecliptic solar degree and remove by lodge sequence to obtain the fixed new moon, quarter, and full moon added-time ecliptic lunar degree and parts-seconds.

sentences.zh: 求夜半午中入轉

translations.literal: To find revolution entry at midnight and noon.
translations.idiomatic: To find revolution entry at midnight and noon.

sentences.zh: 置經朔入轉，以經朔小餘減之，為經朔夜半入轉。

translations.literal: Set the mean new moon revolution entry; subtract the mean new moon minor remainder to obtain the mean new moon midnight revolution entry.
translations.idiomatic: Set the mean new moon revolution entry and subtract the mean new moon minor remainder to obtain the mean new moon midnight revolution entry.

sentences.zh: 又經朔小餘與半法相減之餘，以加減經朔加時入轉，經朔少，如半法加之；

translations.literal: Also the remainder of subtracting the mean new moon minor remainder from the half divisor is used to add or subtract the mean new moon added-time revolution entry; if the mean new moon is less, when like the half divisor add it;
translations.idiomatic: Also take the remainder of the mean new moon minor remainder minus the half divisor to add or subtract the mean new moon added-time revolution entry; if the mean new moon is less, when like the half divisor add;

sentences.zh: 多，如半法減之。

translations.literal: if more, when like the half divisor subtract it.
translations.idiomatic: if more, when like the half divisor subtract.

sentences.zh: 為經朔午中入轉。

translations.literal: That is the mean new moon noon revolution entry.
translations.idiomatic: That is the mean new moon noon revolution entry.

sentences.zh: 若定朔大餘有進退者，亦加減轉入，否則因經為定。

translations.literal: If the fixed new moon major remainder has advance or retreat, also add or subtract revolution entry; otherwise follow the mean for the fixed.
translations.idiomatic: If the fixed new moon major remainder advances or retreats, also add or subtract revolution entry; otherwise take the fixed from the mean.

sentences.zh: 每月累加一日，滿終日及餘秒去命如前，各得每日夜半、午中入轉。

translations.literal: Each month cumulatively add one day; when full days and remainder seconds are reached, remove and name as before—each day's midnight and noon revolution entry is obtained.
translations.idiomatic: Each month add one day cumulatively; when full days and remainder seconds are reached, remove and name as before to obtain each day's midnight and noon revolution entry.

sentences.zh: 求夜半，因定朔夜半入轉累加之。

translations.literal: To find midnight, cumulatively add from the fixed new moon midnight revolution entry.
translations.idiomatic: To find midnight, cumulatively add from the fixed new moon midnight revolution entry.

sentences.zh: 求午中，因定朔午中入轉累加之。

translations.literal: To find noon, cumulatively add from the fixed new moon noon revolution entry.
translations.idiomatic: To find noon, cumulatively add from the fixed new moon noon revolution entry.

sentences.zh: 求加時入轉者，如求加時入氣術。

translations.literal: To find added-time revolution entry, use the method for finding added-time qi entry.
translations.idiomatic: To find added-time revolution entry, use the method for added-time qi entry.

sentences.zh: 求加時及夜半月度

translations.literal: To find the added-time and midnight lunar degrees.
translations.idiomatic: To find the added-time and midnight lunar degrees.

sentences.zh: 置其日入轉算外轉定分，以定朔、弦、望小餘乘之，如日法而一，為加時轉分。

translations.literal: Set that day's revolution entry beyond the revolution count, the fixed revolution parts outside the count; multiply by the fixed new moon, quarter, or full moon minor remainder; divide by the day divisor for one to obtain added-time revolution parts.
translations.idiomatic: Set that day's revolution entry beyond the revolution count and the fixed revolution parts outside the count; multiply by the fixed new moon, quarter, or full moon minor remainder and divide by the day divisor to obtain added-time revolution parts.

sentences.zh: 分滿百為度。

translations.literal: When parts fill 100, that makes degrees.
translations.idiomatic: When parts fill 100, that makes degrees.

sentences.zh: 減定朔、弦、望加時月度，為夜半月度。

translations.literal: Subtract from the fixed new moon, quarter, or full moon added-time lunar degree to obtain the midnight lunar degree.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract from the fixed new moon, quarter, or full moon added-time lunar degree to obtain the midnight lunar degree.

sentences.zh: 以所得轉定分累加之，即得每日夜半月度。

translations.literal: Cumulatively add the revolution fixed parts obtained, and you obtain each day's midnight lunar degree.
translations.idiomatic: Cumulatively add the revolution fixed parts obtained to obtain each day's midnight lunar degree.

sentences.zh: 或朔至弦、望，或至後朔，皆可累加之。

translations.literal: Whether from new moon to quarter or full moon, or to the next new moon, all may be cumulatively added.
translations.idiomatic: Whether from new moon to quarter or full moon, or to the following new moon, all may be cumulatively added.

sentences.zh: 然近則差少，遠則差多。

translations.literal: Yet near at hand the discrepancy is small; far away it is large.
translations.idiomatic: Yet nearby the discrepancy is small; at a distance it is large.

sentences.zh: 置所求前後夜半相距月度為行度，計其相距入轉積度，與行度相減，餘以相距日數除為日差，行度多以日差加每日轉定分，行度少以日差減每日轉定分，然後用之可中。

translations.literal: Set the lunar degrees between the sought preceding and following midnights as travel degrees; compute the accumulated revolution degrees between them and subtract from the travel degrees; divide the remainder by the number of intervening days for the daily difference; if travel degrees are many, add the daily difference to each day's revolution fixed parts; if few, subtract the daily difference—then use it and you can hit center.
translations.idiomatic: Set the lunar degrees between the sought preceding and following midnights as travel degrees; compute the accumulated revolution degrees between them and subtract from the travel degrees; divide the remainder by the intervening days for the daily difference; if travel degrees are greater, add the daily difference to each day's revolution fixed parts; if less, subtract—then use it and results will center.

sentences.zh: 或欲速求，用此數，欲究其故，宜用後術。

translations.literal: If one wishes a quick result, use this number; if one wishes to probe the reason, the later procedure should be used.
translations.idiomatic: For a quick result use this method; to probe the underlying reason, use the later procedure.

sentences.zh: 求晨昏月度

translations.literal: To find the dawn and dusk lunar degrees.
translations.idiomatic: To find the dawn and dusk lunar degrees.

sentences.zh: 置其日晨分，乘其日算外轉定分，日法而一，為晨轉分。

translations.literal: Set that day's dawn parts; multiply the revolution fixed parts outside that day's count; divide by the day divisor for one to obtain dawn revolution parts.
translations.idiomatic: Set that day's dawn parts, multiply the revolution fixed parts outside that day's count, and divide by the day divisor to obtain dawn revolution parts.

sentences.zh: 用減定分，餘為昏轉分。

translations.literal: Use it to subtract the fixed parts; the remainder is dusk revolution parts.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract from the fixed parts; the remainder is dusk revolution parts.

sentences.zh: 又以朔、弦、望定小餘、乘轉定分，日法而一，為加時分。

translations.literal: Again multiply the fixed new moon, quarter, or full moon minor remainder by the revolution fixed parts; divide by the day divisor for one to obtain added-time parts.
translations.idiomatic: Again multiply the fixed new moon, quarter, or full moon minor remainder by the revolution fixed parts and divide by the day divisor to obtain added-time parts.

sentences.zh: 以減晨、昏轉分，為前；

translations.literal: Subtract from the dawn and dusk revolution parts—that is before;
translations.idiomatic: Subtract from the dawn and dusk revolution parts—that is before;

sentences.zh: 不足，覆減之，為後。

translations.literal: if insufficient, reverse-subtract it—that is after.
translations.idiomatic: if insufficient, reverse-subtract—that is after.

sentences.zh: 乃前加後減加時月度，即晨昏月所在宿度及分秒。

translations.literal: Then before adds and after subtracts from the added-time lunar degree, and you obtain the lodge degree and parts-seconds where the moon is at dawn and dusk.
translations.idiomatic: Then add before and subtract after from the added-time lunar degree to obtain the lodge degree and parts-seconds of the moon at dawn and dusk.

sentences.zh: 求朔弦望晨昏定程

translations.literal: To find the fixed intervals of dawn and dusk for new moon, quarters, and full moon.
translations.idiomatic: To find the fixed dawn-and-dusk intervals for new moon, first and last quarter, and full moon.

sentences.zh: 各以其朔昏定月，減上弦昏定月，餘為朔後昏定程。

translations.literal: Each subtract that month's dusk fixed moon from the first quarter dusk fixed moon; the remainder is the fixed interval after new moon at dusk.
translations.idiomatic: Each subtract that month's new moon dusk fixed moon from the first quarter dusk fixed moon; the remainder is the fixed dusk interval after new moon.

sentences.zh: 以上弦昏定月，減望昏定，餘為上弦後昏定程。

translations.literal: Subtract the full moon dusk fixed moon from the first quarter dusk fixed moon; the remainder is the fixed interval after the first quarter at dusk.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the full moon dusk fixed moon from the first quarter dusk fixed moon; the remainder is the fixed dusk interval after the first quarter.

sentences.zh: 以望晨定月，減下弦晨定月，餘為望後晨定程。

translations.literal: Subtract the last quarter dawn fixed moon from the full moon dawn fixed moon; the remainder is the fixed interval after full moon at dawn.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the last quarter dawn fixed moon from the full moon dawn fixed moon; the remainder is the fixed dawn interval after full moon.

sentences.zh: 以下弦晨定月，減後朔晨定月，餘為下弦後晨定程。

translations.literal: Subtract the following new moon dawn fixed moon from the last quarter dawn fixed moon; the remainder is the fixed interval after the last quarter at dawn.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the following new moon dawn fixed moon from the last quarter dawn fixed moon; the remainder is the fixed dawn interval after the last quarter.

sentences.zh: 求每日轉定度

translations.literal: To find the daily fixed revolution degrees.
translations.idiomatic: To find the daily fixed revolution degrees.

sentences.zh: 累計每程相距日下轉積度，與晨昏定程相減，餘以相距日數除之，為日差，定程多加之，定程少減之。

translations.literal: Cumulatively total the revolution accumulated degrees below each interval's intervening days and subtract from the dawn-and-dusk fixed interval; divide the remainder by the number of intervening days for the daily difference; if the fixed interval is greater, add it; if less, subtract it.
translations.idiomatic: Cumulatively total the revolution accumulated degrees below each interval's intervening days and subtract from the dawn-and-dusk fixed interval; divide the remainder by the intervening days for the daily difference; if the fixed interval is greater, add; if less, subtract.

sentences.zh: 以加減每日轉定分，為轉定度。

translations.literal: Add or subtract the daily revolution fixed parts thereby to obtain the fixed revolution degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Add or subtract the daily revolution fixed parts thereby to obtain the fixed revolution degrees.

sentences.zh: 因朔、弦、望晨昏月，每日累加之，滿宿次去之，為每日晨昏月度及分秒。

translations.literal: Starting from the new moon, quarter, and full moon dawn-and-dusk moons, cumulatively add each day; when full, remove by lodge sequence to obtain each day's dawn-and-dusk lunar degree and parts-seconds.
translations.idiomatic: From the new moon, quarter, and full moon dawn-and-dusk moons, add each day cumulatively; when full, remove by lodge sequence to obtain each day's dawn-and-dusk lunar degree and parts-seconds.

sentences.zh: 凡注曆：朔日以後注昏月，望後一日注晨月。

translations.literal: Whenever entering a calendar: from the new moon day onward enter the dusk moon; from the day after full moon enter the dawn moon.
translations.idiomatic: When annotating a calendar: from the new moon day onward record the dusk moon; from the day after full moon record the dawn moon.

sentences.zh: 古曆有九道月度，其數雖繁，亦難削去，具其術如後。

translations.literal: Ancient calendars had Nine Paths lunar degrees; though the numbers are cumbersome, they are hard to cut away—the method is set forth below.
translations.idiomatic: Ancient calendars had Nine Paths lunar degrees; though the reckoning is cumbersome, it is hard to omit—the method is given below.

sentences.zh: 求平交日辰

translations.literal: To find the mean conjunction date and double-hour.
translations.idiomatic: To find the mean conjunction date and double-hour.

sentences.zh: 置交終日及餘秒，以其月經朔加時入交泛日及餘秒減之，為平交入其月經朔加時後日及餘秒。

translations.literal: Set the conjunction cycle days and remainder seconds; subtract the month's mean new moon added-time generalized conjunction days and remainder seconds from them to obtain the mean conjunction days and remainder seconds after that month's mean new moon added time.
translations.idiomatic: Set the conjunction-cycle days and remainder seconds; subtract that month's mean new moon added-time generalized conjunction days and remainder seconds to obtain the mean conjunction days and remainder seconds after that month's mean new moon added time.

sentences.zh: 以加其月經朔大小餘，其大餘命甲子算外，即平交日辰及餘秒。

translations.literal: Add to that month’s mean new moon greater and lesser remainders; name the greater remainder from jiazi outside the count—that is the mean crossing day and double-hour with remainder and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Add them to the month’s mean new moon greater and lesser remainders, name the greater remainder from jiazi outside the count, and obtain the mean crossing day, double-hour, and remainder-seconds.

sentences.zh: 求次交者，以交終日及餘秒加之，大余滿紀法去之，命如前，即次平交日辰及餘秒。

translations.literal: To seek the next crossing: add crossing-terminal days and remainder-seconds; when the greater remainder fills the era rule remove it; name as before—that is the next mean crossing day and double-hour with remainder and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: For the next crossing, add the crossing-terminal days and remainder-seconds, cast out full era rules from the greater remainder, name as before, and obtain the next mean crossing day, double-hour, and remainder-seconds.

sentences.zh: 求平交入轉朓棵定數

translations.literal: Seek mean crossing entry into rotation tuoke fixed number.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to find the mean crossing’s entry into rotation tuoke fixed number.

sentences.zh: 置平交小餘，加其日夜半入轉餘，以乘其日損益率，日法而一，所得，以損益其下朓朒積，為定數。

translations.literal: Set the mean crossing lesser remainder, add that day’s midnight entry-into-rotation remainder, multiply by its daily gain-and-loss rate, divide by the day divisor, and with the result adjust the tuoke accumulation below—that is the fixed number.
translations.idiomatic: Set the mean crossing lesser remainder, add midnight entry-into-rotation remainder for that day, multiply by the daily gain-and-loss rate, divide by the day divisor, and apply the result to the underlying tuoke accumulation to obtain the fixed number.

sentences.zh: 求正交日辰

translations.literal: Seek the true crossing day and double-hour.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to find the true crossing day and double-hour.

sentences.zh: 置平交小余，以平交入轉朓棵定數，朓減朒加之，滿與不足，進退日辰，即正交日辰及餘秒。

translations.literal: Set the mean crossing lesser remainder; with the mean-crossing entry-into-rotation tuoke fixed number, tuoke subtract and tuoke add; when full or short advance or retreat the day and double-hour—that is the true crossing day and double-hour with remainder and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Set the mean crossing lesser remainder, apply the mean-crossing entry-into-rotation tuoke fixed number (tuoke subtract, tuoke add), and advance or retreat the day and double-hour as needed to obtain the true crossing day, double-hour, and remainder-seconds.

sentences.zh: 與定朔日辰相距，即所在月日。

translations.literal: Its distance from the fixed new moon day and double-hour is the month and day where it falls.
translations.idiomatic: Its interval from the fixed new moon day and double-hour gives the month and day in question.

sentences.zh: 求經朔加時中積

translations.literal: Seek the mean new moon hour-of-addition central accumulation.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to find the mean new moon central accumulation at hour-of-addition.

sentences.zh: 各以其月經朔加入氣日及餘，加其氣中積餘，其日命為度，其餘以日法退除為分秒，即其經朔加時中積度及分秒。

translations.literal: For each, take that month’s mean new moon entry into qi days and remainder and add its qi central accumulation remainder; name the days as degrees and convert the remainder by the day divisor into minutes and seconds—that is the mean new moon hour-of-addition central accumulation in degrees, minutes, and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: For each month, add the mean new moon’s entry-into-qi days and remainder to the qi central accumulation remainder, treat days as degrees, convert the remainder by the day divisor into minutes and seconds, and obtain the mean new moon central accumulation at hour-of-addition.

sentences.zh: 求正交加時黃道月度

translations.literal: Seek the true-crossing hour-of-addition ecliptic lunar degree.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to find the ecliptic lunar degree at true crossing hour-of-addition.

sentences.zh: 置平交入經朔加時後算及餘秒，以日法通日，內餘，進二位，如三萬九千一百二十一分為度，不滿退除為分秒，以加其月經朔加時中積，然後以冬至加時黃道日度加而命之，即其得其月正交加時月離黃道宿度及分秒。

translations.literal: Set the count and remainder-seconds of mean crossing after the month’s mean new moon hour-of-addition; communicate days by the day divisor and include the remainder, advance two places, take 39,121 parts as degrees, convert what does not fill by retreating into minutes and seconds, add to the month’s mean new moon hour-of-addition central accumulation, then add and name from the winter solstice hour-of-addition ecliptic solar degree—that is the sought month’s true-crossing hour-of-addition lunar ecliptic lodge degree with minutes and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Set mean crossing after the month’s mean new moon hour-of-addition (count and remainder-seconds), convert days through the day divisor with the remainder, shift two places, take 39,121 as the degree divisor, reduce the remainder to minutes and seconds, add to the mean new moon hour-of-addition central accumulation, then add to the winter solstice ecliptic solar degree at hour-of-addition and name the lodge—the true-crossing hour-of-addition ecliptic lunar degree and minutes and seconds for that month.

sentences.zh: 如求次交者，以交終度及秒加而命之，即得所求。

translations.literal: As when seeking the next crossing: add crossing-terminal degrees and seconds and name—that is what is sought.
translations.idiomatic: As for the next crossing, add crossing-terminal degrees and seconds and name the lodge to obtain the value sought.

sentences.zh: 求黃道宿積度

translations.literal: Seek ecliptic lodge accumulated degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to find ecliptic lodge accumulated degrees.

sentences.zh: 置正交時黃道宿全度，以正交加時月離黃道宿度及分秒減之，餘為距後度及分秒，以黃道宿度累加之，即各得正交後黃道宿積度及分秒。

translations.literal: Set the full ecliptic lodge degree at true crossing, subtract the true-crossing hour-of-addition lunar ecliptic lodge degree and minutes and seconds; the remainder is the post-distance degree and minutes and seconds; accumulate ecliptic lodge degrees—each yields the post-true-crossing ecliptic lodge accumulated degree and minutes and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Set the full ecliptic lodge at true crossing, subtract the true-crossing hour-of-addition lunar ecliptic degree and minutes and seconds, take the remainder as the post-distance, and add ecliptic lodge widths cumulatively to obtain each post-true-crossing ecliptic accumulation in degrees and minutes and seconds.

sentences.zh: 求黃道宿積度入初末限

translations.literal: Seek entry into initial and terminal limit for ecliptic lodge accumulated degree.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to find whether an ecliptic lodge accumulation falls in the initial or terminal limit.

sentences.zh: 置黃道宿積度及分秒，滿交象度及分秒去之，如在半交象以下，為初限；

translations.literal: Set the ecliptic lodge accumulated degree and minutes and seconds; remove full crossing-image degrees and minutes and seconds; if at or below half the crossing image, it is the initial limit;
translations.idiomatic: Set the ecliptic lodge accumulation in degrees and minutes and seconds, cast out full crossing-image degrees and minutes and seconds; if it is at or below half the crossing image, it is in the initial limit;

sentences.zh: 以上者，以減交象度及分秒，餘為入末限。

translations.literal: if above, subtract from crossing-image degrees and minutes and seconds; the remainder is entry into the terminal limit.
translations.idiomatic: if above, subtract it from the crossing-image degrees and minutes and seconds; the remainder is entry into the terminal limit.

sentences.zh: 入交積度交象度並在交會術中。

translations.literal: Entry-into-crossing accumulated degree and crossing-image degree are both in the crossing-conjunction procedure.
translations.idiomatic: Entry-into-crossing accumulation and crossing-image degree both belong to the crossing-conjunction procedure.

sentences.zh: 求月行九道宿度

translations.literal: Seek the moon’s nine-path lodge degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to find the moon’s nine-path lodge degrees.

sentences.zh: 凡月行所交：冬入陰曆，夏入陽曆，月行青道。

translations.literal: In general the moon’s crossings: in winter it enters the yin sequence, in summer the yang sequence—the moon follows the green path.
translations.idiomatic: In general, when the moon crosses: in winter it enters the yin sequence and in summer the yang sequence, and the moon runs the green path.

sentences.zh: 冬至夏至後，青道半交在春分之宿，當黃道東。

translations.literal: After winter solstice and summer solstice, the green path’s half-crossing lies at the spring-equinox lodges, east of the ecliptic.
translations.idiomatic: After winter and summer solstice, the green path’s half-crossing stands at the spring-equinox lodges, east of the ecliptic.

sentences.zh: 立冬立夏後，青道半交在立春之宿，當黃道東南。

translations.literal: After Start of Winter and Start of Summer, the green path’s half-crossing lies at the Start-of-Spring lodges, southeast of the ecliptic.
translations.idiomatic: After Start of Winter and Start of Summer, the green path’s half-crossing lies at the Start-of-Spring lodges, southeast of the ecliptic.

sentences.zh: 至所沖之宿亦如之。

translations.literal: At the lodges opposite them it is likewise.
translations.idiomatic: The same holds at the opposite lodges.

sentences.zh: 冬入陽曆，夏入陰曆，月行白道。

translations.literal: In winter it enters the yang sequence, in summer the yin sequence—the moon follows the white path.
translations.idiomatic: In winter it enters the yang sequence and in summer the yin sequence, and the moon runs the white path.

sentences.zh: 冬至夏至後，白道半交在秋分之宿，當黃道西。

translations.literal: After winter solstice and summer solstice, the white path’s half-crossing lies at the autumn-equinox lodges, west of the ecliptic.
translations.idiomatic: After winter and summer solstice, the white path’s half-crossing stands at the autumn-equinox lodges, west of the ecliptic.

sentences.zh: 立冬立夏後，白道半交在立秋之宿，當黃道西北。

translations.literal: After Start of Winter and Start of Summer, the white path’s half-crossing lies at the Start-of-Autumn lodges, northwest of the ecliptic.
translations.idiomatic: After Start of Winter and Start of Summer, the white path’s half-crossing lies at the Start-of-Autumn lodges, northwest of the ecliptic.

sentences.zh: 至所沖之宿亦如之。

translations.literal: At the lodges opposite them it is likewise.
translations.idiomatic: The same holds at the opposite lodges.

sentences.zh: 春入陽曆，秋入陰曆，月行硃道。

translations.literal: In spring it enters the yang sequence, in autumn the yin sequence—the moon follows the cinnabar path.
translations.idiomatic: In spring it enters the yang sequence and in autumn the yin sequence, and the moon runs the cinnabar path.

sentences.zh: 春分秋分後，硃道半交在夏至之宿，當黃道南。

translations.literal: After spring equinox and autumn equinox, the cinnabar path’s half-crossing lies at the summer-solstice lodges, south of the ecliptic.
translations.idiomatic: After the spring and autumn equinoxes, the cinnabar path’s half-crossing stands at the summer-solstice lodges, south of the ecliptic.

sentences.zh: 立春立秋後，硃道半交在立夏之宿，當黃道西南。

translations.literal: After Start of Spring and Start of Autumn, the cinnabar path’s half-crossing lies at the Start-of-Summer lodges, southwest of the ecliptic.
translations.idiomatic: After Start of Spring and Start of Autumn, the cinnabar path’s half-crossing lies at the Start-of-Summer lodges, southwest of the ecliptic.

sentences.zh: 至所沖之宿亦如之。

translations.literal: At the lodges opposite them it is likewise.
translations.idiomatic: The same holds at the opposite lodges.

sentences.zh: 春入陰曆，秋入陽曆，月行黑道。

translations.literal: In spring it enters the yin sequence, in autumn the yang sequence—the moon follows the black path.
translations.idiomatic: In spring it enters the yin sequence and in autumn the yang sequence, and the moon runs the black path.

sentences.zh: 春分秋分後，黑道半交在冬至之宿當黃道北。

translations.literal: After spring equinox and autumn equinox, the black path’s half-crossing lies at the winter-solstice lodges, north of the ecliptic.
translations.idiomatic: After the spring and autumn equinoxes, the black path’s half-crossing stands at the winter-solstice lodges, north of the ecliptic.

sentences.zh: 立春立秋後，黑道半交在立冬之宿，當黃道東北。

translations.literal: After Start of Spring and Start of Autumn, the black path’s half-crossing lies at the Start-of-Winter lodges, northeast of the ecliptic.
translations.idiomatic: After Start of Spring and Start of Autumn, the black path’s half-crossing lies at the Start-of-Winter lodges, northeast of the ecliptic.

sentences.zh: 至所沖之宿亦如之。

translations.literal: At the lodges opposite them it is likewise.
translations.idiomatic: The same holds at the opposite lodges.

sentences.zh: 四序離為八節，至陰陽之所交，皆與黃道相會，故月行有九道。

translations.literal: The four seasons divide into eight nodes; where yin and yang meet all join the ecliptic—hence the moon’s nine paths.
translations.idiomatic: The four seasons split into eight nodes; wherever yin and yang cross they meet the ecliptic, so the moon has nine paths.

sentences.zh: 各以所入初末限度及分秒，減一百一度，餘以所入初末限度及分乘之，半而退位為分，分滿百為度，命為月道與黃道泛差。

translations.literal: For each, take its entry initial or terminal limit degrees and minutes and seconds, subtract from 101°; multiply the remainder by the initial or terminal limit degrees and minutes; halve and retreat one place for minutes; when minutes fill one hundred make degrees—name it the moon path’s provisional difference from the ecliptic.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract each entry’s initial or terminal limit from 101°, multiply by that limit’s degrees and minutes, halve and shift one place for minutes, convert hundreds into degrees, and name the result the moon path’s provisional ecliptic difference.

sentences.zh: 凡日以赤道內為陰，外為陽；

translations.literal: In general the sun takes inside the equator as yin and outside as yang;
translations.idiomatic: In general the sun treats inside the equator as yin and outside as yang;

sentences.zh: 月以黃道內為陰，外為陽。

translations.literal: the moon takes inside the ecliptic as yin and outside as yang.
translations.idiomatic: the moon treats inside the ecliptic as yin and outside as yang.

sentences.zh: 故月行正交，入夏至後宿度內為同名，入冬至後宿度內為異名。

translations.literal: Hence at true crossing, entry into lodge degrees after summer solstice within is same name; entry into lodge degrees after winter solstice within is different name.
translations.idiomatic: At true crossing, lodge degrees after summer solstice within the ecliptic are same name; those after winter solstice within are different name.

sentences.zh: 其在同名者，置月行與黃道泛差，九因八約之，為定差，半交後，正交前，以差減；

translations.literal: For same name: set the moon path’s provisional difference from the ecliptic, multiply by nine and reduce by eight for the fixed difference; after half-crossing and before true crossing subtract the difference;
translations.idiomatic: In the same-name case, set the moon path’s provisional ecliptic difference, multiply by nine and reduce by eight for the fixed difference; after half-crossing and before true crossing subtract it;

sentences.zh: 正交後，半交前，以差加。

translations.literal: after true crossing and before half-crossing add the difference.
translations.idiomatic: after true crossing and before half-crossing add it.

sentences.zh: 此加減出入六度，正，如黃赤道相交同名之差，若較之漸異，則隨交所在，遷變不同也。

translations.literal: This addition and subtraction ranges within six degrees; when correct it matches the same-name difference where the yellow and red paths cross; if compared it gradually differs, then with the crossing’s position the shift varies.
translations.idiomatic: This adjustment stays within six degrees; when aligned it matches the same-name latitude difference at the ecliptic–equator crossing, but compared it diverges gradually as the crossing position shifts.

sentences.zh: 仍以正交度距秋分度數，乘定差，如象限而一，所得為月道與赤道定差。

translations.literal: Still take the true-crossing degree’s distance from the autumn-equinox degree, multiply the fixed difference, divide by the image limit—the result is the moon path’s fixed difference from the equator.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply the fixed difference by the true-crossing degree’s distance from the autumn equinox and divide by the image limit to obtain the moon path’s fixed equator difference.

sentences.zh: 前加者為減，減者為加。

translations.literal: What was added before becomes subtracted; what was subtracted becomes added.
translations.idiomatic: Prior additions become subtractions and prior subtractions become additions.

sentences.zh: 其中異名者，置月行與黃道泛差，七因八約之，為定差。

translations.literal: Among them, for different name: set the moon path’s provisional difference from the ecliptic, multiply by seven and reduce by eight for the fixed difference.
translations.idiomatic: In the different-name case, set the moon path’s provisional ecliptic difference, multiply by seven and reduce by eight for the fixed difference.

sentences.zh: 半交後，以差加；

translations.literal: After half-crossing add the difference;
translations.idiomatic: After half-crossing add the difference;

sentences.zh: 正交後，半交前，以差減。

translations.literal: after true crossing and before half-crossing subtract the difference.
translations.idiomatic: after true crossing and before half-crossing subtract it.

sentences.zh: 此加減出入六度，異，如黃道赤道相交異名之差，較之漸同，則隨交所遷變不常。

translations.literal: This addition and subtraction ranges within six degrees; when different it matches the different-name difference where the yellow and red paths cross; compared it gradually converges, yet with the crossing’s shift it is not constant.
translations.idiomatic: This adjustment also stays within six degrees; in the different-name case it matches the ecliptic–equator crossing’s different-name difference and gradually converges when compared, though it still shifts with the crossing.

sentences.zh: 仍以正交度距春分度數，乘定差，如象限而一，所得為月道與赤道定差。

translations.literal: Still take the true-crossing degree’s distance from the spring-equinox degree, multiply the fixed difference, divide by the image limit—the result is the moon path’s fixed difference from the equator.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply the fixed difference by the true-crossing degree’s distance from the spring equinox and divide by the image limit to obtain the moon path’s fixed equator difference.

sentences.zh: 前加者為減，減者為加。

translations.literal: Where previously add, now subtract; where subtract, now add.
translations.idiomatic: Where the prior step added, subtract; where it subtracted, add.

sentences.zh: 各加減黃道宿積度，為九道宿積度。

translations.literal: To each add and subtract the ecliptic lodge accumulated degree — these are the nine-path lodge accumulated degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Apply the additions and subtractions to each ecliptic lodge accumulated degree to obtain the nine-path lodge accumulated degrees.

sentences.zh: 以前宿九道積度減之，為其宿九道度及分。

translations.literal: Subtract the previous lodge's nine-path accumulation — that is this lodge's nine-path degree and parts.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the preceding lodge's nine-path accumulation to obtain this lodge's nine-path degree and parts.

sentences.zh: 其分就近約為太半少。

translations.literal: Its parts are rounded to the nearest great, half, or small.
translations.idiomatic: Round its parts to the nearest great, half, or small fraction.

sentences.zh: 論春夏秋冬以四時日所在宿度為正。

translations.literal: For spring, summer, autumn, and winter, the lodge degree where the sun stands in each season is taken as the standard.
translations.idiomatic: Spring, summer, autumn, and winter are judged by the lodge degree where the sun stands in each season's day.

sentences.zh: 求正交加時月離九道宿度

translations.literal: To find the true-nodal crossing hour moon departure nine-path lodge degree.
translations.idiomatic: To find the nine-path lodge degree of moon departure at the true-nodal crossing hour.

sentences.zh: 以正交加時黃道日度及分，減一百一度，餘以正交度及分乘之，半而退位為分，分滿百為度，命為月道與黃道泛差。

translations.literal: Set the ecliptic solar degree and parts at the true-nodal crossing hour; subtract 101 degrees; with the remainder multiply the nodal degree and parts; halve and step back one place for parts; when parts fill 100 they become degrees — name this the general difference between the lunar path and the ecliptic.
translations.idiomatic: Set the ecliptic solar degree and parts at true-nodal crossing hour, subtract 101°, multiply the remainder by the nodal degree and parts, halve and shift one place for parts, convert hundreds to degrees, and name the result the general difference between lunar path and ecliptic.

sentences.zh: 其在同名者，置月行與黃道泛差。

translations.literal: When of the same name, set the general difference between lunar motion and the ecliptic.
translations.idiomatic: In the same-name case, set the general difference between lunar motion and the ecliptic.

sentences.zh: 九因八約之，為定差，以加；

translations.literal: Reduce by nine-eighths to make the fixed difference, and add;
translations.idiomatic: Reduce by nine-eighths to obtain the fixed difference, then add;

sentences.zh: 仍以正交度距秋分度數，乘定差，如象限而一，所得為月道與赤道定差，以減，其在異名者，置月行與黃道泛差，七因八約之，為定差，以減；

translations.literal: Still multiply the fixed difference by the nodal degree's distance in degrees from the autumn equinox, as one part of the quadrant limit — the result is the fixed difference between the lunar path and the equator, and subtract; when of different name, set the general difference between lunar motion and the ecliptic, reduce by seven-eighths to make the fixed difference, and subtract;
translations.idiomatic: Still multiply the fixed difference by the nodal degree's distance from the autumn equinox and divide by the quadrant limit for the lunar-path–equator fixed difference, and subtract; in the different-name case, set the lunar-motion–ecliptic general difference, reduce by seven-eighths for the fixed difference, and subtract;

sentences.zh: 仍以正交度距春分度數，乘定差，如象限而一，所得為月道與赤道定差，以加。

translations.literal: Still multiply the fixed difference by the nodal degree's distance in degrees from the spring equinox, as one part of the quadrant limit — the result is the fixed difference between the lunar path and the equator, and add.
translations.idiomatic: Still multiply the fixed difference by the nodal degree's distance from the spring equinox and divide by the quadrant limit for the lunar-path–equator fixed difference, and add.

sentences.zh: 置正交加時黃道月度及分，以二差加減之，即為正交加時月離九道宿度及分。

translations.literal: Set the ecliptic lunar degree and parts at the true-nodal crossing hour; add and subtract by the two differences — that is the true-nodal crossing hour moon departure nine-path lodge degree and parts.
translations.idiomatic: Set the ecliptic lunar degree and parts at true-nodal crossing hour, apply both differences, and obtain the nine-path lodge degree and parts of moon departure at true-nodal crossing hour.

sentences.zh: 求定朔望加時月所在度

translations.literal: To find the lodge degree where the moon stands at the fixed new and full moon hours.
translations.idiomatic: To find the lodge degree of the moon at fixed new and full moon hours.

sentences.zh: 置定朔加時日躔黃道宿次，凡合朔加時，月行潛在日下，與太陽同度，是為加時月離宿次。

translations.literal: Set the ecliptic solar progression lodge at the fixed new-moon hour; for every conjunction hour the moon moves hidden beneath the sun at the same degree — that is the moon-departure lodge at the hour.
translations.idiomatic: Set the ecliptic solar-progression lodge at fixed new moon; at conjunction the moon lies hidden beneath the sun at the same degree, which is the moon-departure lodge at that hour.

sentences.zh: 各以弦、望度及分秒，加其所當弦、望加時月躔黃道宿度，滿宿次去之，命如前，各得定朔、弦、望加時月所在黃道宿度及分秒。

translations.literal: To each add the first- and third-quarter and full-moon degrees and parts seconds to the corresponding first- and third-quarter and full-moon hour ecliptic solar-progression lodge degree; when full remove by lodge count and name as before — each yields the ecliptic lodge degree and parts seconds where the moon stands at the fixed new, first quarter, third quarter, and full moon hours.
translations.idiomatic: Add the chord, quarter, and full-moon degrees and parts to each corresponding hour's ecliptic solar-progression lodge degree, discard full lodge counts and assign mansions as before, and obtain the ecliptic lodge degree and parts where the moon stands at each fixed new moon, quarter, and full moon hour.

sentences.zh: 求定朔弦望加時九道月度

translations.literal: To find the nine-path lunar degree at the fixed new, first quarter, third quarter, and full moon hours.
translations.idiomatic: To find the nine-path lunar degree at fixed new moon, quarters, and full moon.

sentences.zh: 各以朔、弦、望加時月離黃道宿度及分秒，加前宿正交後黃道積度，為定朔、弦、望加時正交後黃道積度。

translations.literal: To each add the new, first quarter, third quarter, and full moon hour moon-departure ecliptic lodge degree and parts seconds to the previous lodge's post-nodal ecliptic accumulated degree after the true crossing — that is the post-nodal ecliptic accumulated degree at the fixed new, first quarter, third quarter, and full moon hour.
translations.idiomatic: Add each new, quarter, and full moon hour's moon-departure ecliptic lodge degree and parts to the preceding lodge's post-true-nodal ecliptic accumulation to obtain the post-nodal ecliptic accumulation at each fixed new moon, quarter, and full moon hour.

sentences.zh: 如前求九道積度，以前宿九道積度減之，餘為定朔、弦、望加時九道月離宿度及分秒。

translations.literal: As before seek the nine-path accumulated degree; subtract the previous lodge's nine-path accumulation — the remainder is the nine-path moon-departure lodge degree and parts seconds at the fixed new, first quarter, third quarter, and full moon hours.
translations.idiomatic: Find the nine-path accumulation as before, subtract the preceding lodge's nine-path accumulation, and the remainder is the nine-path moon-departure lodge degree and parts at each fixed new moon, quarter, and full moon hour.

sentences.zh: 其合朔加時，若非正交，則日在黃道，月在九道，所入宿度，雖多少不同，考其兩極，若應繩准。

translations.literal: At conjunction hour, if it is not a true nodal crossing, the sun is on the ecliptic and the moon on the nine paths; the lodges entered may differ in degree, yet comparing the two poles they align as if by plumb line and level.
translations.idiomatic: At conjunction, if not at true nodal crossing, the sun lies on the ecliptic and the moon on the nine paths; entered lodges may differ in degree, yet the two poles align as if by plumb and level.

sentences.zh: 故雲：月行潛在日下，與太陽同度，即為加時九道月度。

translations.literal: Hence it is said: the moon moves hidden beneath the sun at the same degree — that is the nine-path lunar degree at the hour.
translations.idiomatic: Hence: when the moon moves hidden beneath the sun at the same degree, that is the nine-path lunar degree at the hour.

sentences.zh: 其求晨昏夜半月度，並依前術。

translations.literal: To seek dawn, dusk, and midnight lunar degrees, all follow the preceding procedure.
translations.idiomatic: Dawn, dusk, and midnight lunar degrees are all found by the preceding procedure.

translations.literal: Step Convergence 6
translations.idiomatic: Step Convergence 6

sentences.zh: 交終分：一十四萬二千三百一十九，秒九千三百六十八。

translations.literal: Convergence termination parts: 142,319, seconds 9,368.
translations.idiomatic: Convergence termination parts: 142,319, seconds 9,368.

sentences.zh: 交終日：二十七日，餘一千一百九分，秒九千三百六十八。

translations.literal: Convergence termination day: 27 days, remainder 1,109 parts, seconds 9,368.
translations.idiomatic: Convergence termination day: 27 days, remainder 1,109 parts, seconds 9,368.

sentences.zh: 交中日：十三，餘三千一百六十九，秋九千六百八十四。

translations.literal: Convergence middle day: 13, remainder 3,169, seconds 9,684.
translations.idiomatic: Convergence middle day: 13, remainder 3,169, seconds 9,684.

sentences.zh: 交朔日：二，餘一千六百六十五，秒六百三十二。

translations.idiomatic: Convergence new-moon day: 2, remainder 1,665, seconds 632.

sentences.zh: 交望日：十四，餘四千二，秒五千。

translations.idiomatic: Convergence full-moon day: 14, remainder 4,002, seconds 5,000.

translations.idiomatic: Seconds mother: 10,000.

translations.idiomatic: Convergence termination: 363°79′36″.

sentences.zh: 交中：一百八十一度，八十九分，六十八秒。

translations.idiomatic: Convergence middle: 181°89′68″.

translations.idiomatic: Convergence image: 90°94′84″.

sentences.zh: 半交象：四十五度，四十七分，四十二秒。

translations.idiomatic: Half convergence image: 45°47′42″.

translations.idiomatic: Lunar eclipse limit: 5,100.

sentences.zh: 月蝕既限：一千七百。

translations.idiomatic: Lunar eclipse totality limit: 1,700.
