sentences.zh: 求朔望入交

translations.literal: To find new and full moon entry into convergence.
translations.idiomatic: To find new and full moon entry into convergence.

sentences.zh: 置天正朔積分，以交終分去之，不盡，如日法而一，為日，不滿為餘，即天正十一月經朔加時入交泛日及餘秒。

translations.literal: Set the civil new-year new-moon accumulated parts; remove by the convergence termination parts; what does not exhaust, divide by the day factor for days and the remainder for parts — that is the civil eleventh month mean new-moon hour general convergence day and remainder seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Set the civil new-year new-moon accumulated parts, discard full convergence termination parts, divide the remainder by the day factor for days and parts, and obtain the eleventh-month mean new-moon hour general convergence day, remainder, and seconds.

sentences.zh: 交朔加之，得次朔。

translations.literal: Add the convergence new-moon increment — obtain the next new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Add the convergence new-moon increment to obtain the next new moon.

sentences.zh: 交望加之，得次望。

translations.literal: Add the convergence full-moon increment — obtain the next full moon.
translations.idiomatic: Add the convergence full-moon increment to obtain the next full moon.

sentences.zh: 再加交望，亦得次朔。

translations.literal: Add the convergence full-moon increment again — also obtain the next new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Add the convergence full-moon increment again to obtain the next new moon.

sentences.zh: 各為朔、望入交泛日及餘秒

translations.literal: Each yields the new and full moon general convergence day and remainder seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Each yields the general convergence day, remainder, and seconds for every new and full moon.

sentences.zh: 求定朔每日夜半入交

translations.literal: To find the fixed new moon's daily midnight entry into convergence.
translations.idiomatic: To find daily midnight convergence entry for each fixed new moon.

sentences.zh: 各置入交泛日及餘秒，減去經朔、望小餘，即為定朔、望夜半入交泛日及餘秒。

translations.literal: Set each general convergence day and remainder seconds; subtract the mean new- or full-moon minor remainder — that is the fixed new or full moon midnight general convergence day and remainder seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Set each general convergence day and remainder seconds, subtract the mean new- or full-moon minor remainder, and obtain the fixed new or full moon midnight general convergence day and remainder seconds.

sentences.zh: 若定朔、望有進退者，亦進退交日，否則因經為定。

translations.literal: If the fixed new or full moon advances or retreats, advance or retreat the convergence day likewise; otherwise follow the mean value as fixed.
translations.idiomatic: If a fixed new or full moon advances or retreats, adjust the convergence day likewise; otherwise take the mean value as fixed.

sentences.zh: 大月加二日，小月加一日，餘皆加四千一百二十秒六百三十二，即次朔夜半入交。

translations.literal: In a long month add two days, in a short month one day; to the remainder always add 4,120 seconds 632 — that is the next new moon's midnight convergence entry.
translations.idiomatic: Add two days in a long month and one in a short month; always add 4,120 seconds 632 to the remainder for the next new moon's midnight convergence entry.

sentences.zh: 累加一日，滿交終日及餘秒去之，即每日夜半入交泛日及餘秒。

translations.literal: Accumulate one day; when full discard the convergence termination day and remainder-seconds — that is each day's midnight general convergence day and remainder-seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Add one day cumulatively, cast out full convergence termination days and remainder-seconds, and obtain each day's midnight general convergence day and remainder-seconds.

sentences.zh: 求定朔望加時入交

translations.literal: To find fixed new and full moon hour-of-addition entry into convergence.
translations.idiomatic: To find fixed new and full moon hour-of-addition entry into convergence.

sentences.zh: 置經朔、望加時入交泛日及餘秒，以入氣入轉朓棵定數，朓減朒加之，即定朔加時入交泛日及餘秒。

translations.literal: Set the canonical new- and full-moon hour-of-addition general convergence day and remainder-seconds; with the entry-into-qi and entry-into-rotation tiao–chuo fixed numbers, tiao subtract and chuo add — that is the fixed new-moon hour-of-addition general convergence day and remainder-seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Set the canonical new- and full-moon hour-of-addition general convergence day and remainder-seconds, apply the entry-into-qi and entry-into-rotation tiao–chuo fixed numbers (tiao subtract, chuo add), and obtain the fixed new-moon hour-of-addition general convergence day and remainder-seconds.

sentences.zh: 求定朔望加時入交積度及陰陽曆

translations.literal: To find fixed new- and full-moon hour-of-addition entry into convergence accumulated degrees and yang/yin calendar.
translations.idiomatic: To find fixed new- and full-moon hour-of-addition convergence accumulated degrees and yang/yin calendar.

sentences.zh: 置定朔、望加時入交泛日，以日法通之，內餘，進二位，如三萬九千一百二十一而一為度，不滿退除為分秒，即定朔、望加時月行入交積度。

translations.literal: Set the fixed new- and full-moon hour-of-addition general convergence day; communicate it by the day divisor and include the remainder, advance two places, take 39,121 as one degree, reduce what does not fill to parts and seconds — that is the fixed new- and full-moon hour-of-addition moon's entry into convergence accumulated degree.
translations.idiomatic: Set the fixed new- or full-moon hour-of-addition general convergence day, convert through the day divisor with the remainder, shift two places, divide by 39,121 for degrees, reduce the remainder to parts and seconds, and obtain the hour-of-addition moon's entry into convergence accumulated degree.

sentences.zh: 以定朔、望加時入轉遲疾度，遲減疾加之，即月行之入交定積度。

translations.literal: With the fixed new- and full-moon hour-of-addition entry-into-rotation slow-fast degree, slow subtract and fast add — that is the moon's fixed entry into convergence accumulated degree.
translations.idiomatic: Apply the fixed syzygy hour's entry-into-rotation slow-fast degree (slow subtract, fast add) to obtain the moon's fixed entry into convergence accumulated degree.

sentences.zh: 如交中度以下，入陽曆積度；

translations.literal: At or below the convergence middle, it is yang-calendar accumulated degree;
translations.idiomatic: At or below convergence middle counts as yang-calendar accumulated degree;

sentences.zh: 以上，去之，餘為入陰曆積度。

translations.literal: above, remove it; the remainder is yin-calendar accumulated degree.
translations.idiomatic: above, subtract it; the remainder is yin-calendar accumulated degree.

sentences.zh: 每日夜半，准此求之。

translations.literal: Each day at midnight, seek by this procedure.
translations.idiomatic: For each midnight, follow this procedure.

sentences.zh: 求月去黃道度

translations.literal: To find the moon's departure from the yellow path in degrees.
translations.idiomatic: To find the moon's ecliptic latitude (departure from the yellow path).

sentences.zh: 視月入陰陽曆積度及分，如交象以下，為少象；

translations.literal: Inspect the entered yin- or yang-calendar accumulated degree and parts; at or below the convergence image, it is the young image;
translations.idiomatic: Inspect the entered yin- or yang-calendar accumulated degree and parts; at or below the convergence image counts as the young image;

sentences.zh: 以上，覆減交中，餘為老象。

translations.literal: above, cover and subtract the convergence middle; the remainder is the old image.
translations.idiomatic: above, cover and subtract convergence middle; the remainder is the old image.

sentences.zh: 置所入老少象度於上，列交象度於下，相減相乘，倍而退位為分，滿百為度，用減所入老少象度及分，餘又與交中度相減相乘，八因之，以百一十除為分，分滿百為度，即得月去黃道度。

translations.literal: Set the entered young or old image degree above and array the convergence image degree below; subtract and multiply, double and step back one place for parts, when parts fill 100 they become degrees; use that to subtract from the entered young or old image degree and parts; with the remainder again subtract and multiply against the convergence middle, multiply by eight, divide by 110 for parts, when parts fill 100 they become degrees — that is the moon's departure from the yellow path in degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Set the entered young or old image degree above and the convergence image degree below, subtract and multiply, double and shift one place for parts, convert hundreds to degrees, subtract from the entered young or old image degree and parts, then with the remainder subtract and multiply against convergence middle, multiply by eight, divide by 110 for parts, convert hundreds to degrees, and obtain the moon's departure from the yellow path in degrees.

sentences.zh: 求朔望加時入交常日及定日

translations.literal: To find new- and full-moon hour-of-addition general and fixed convergence days.
translations.idiomatic: To find new- and full-moon hour-of-addition general and fixed convergence days.

sentences.zh: 朔望入交泛日，以入氣朓棵定數，朓減朒加之，為入交常日。

translations.literal: For new- and full-moon general convergence day, with the entry-into-qi tiao–chuo fixed number, tiao subtract and chuo add — that is the general convergence day.
translations.idiomatic: Take the new- or full-moon general convergence day, apply the entry-into-qi tiao–chuo fixed number (tiao subtract, chuo add), and obtain the general convergence day.

sentences.zh: 又置入轉朓棵定數，進一位，一百二十七而一，所得朓減朒加入交常日，為入交定日 及餘秒。

translations.literal: Again set the entry-into-rotation tiao–chuo fixed number, advance one place, divide by 127; with the result tiao subtract and chuo add to the general convergence day — that is the fixed convergence day and remainder-seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Set the entry-into-rotation tiao–chuo fixed number, shift one place, divide by 127, apply tiao subtract and chuo add to the general convergence day, and obtain the fixed convergence day and remainder-seconds.

sentences.zh: 求人交陰陽曆前後分

translations.literal: To find human-entry yang/yin calendar before and after parts.
translations.idiomatic: To find human-entry yang/yin calendar before and after parts.

sentences.zh: 視入交定日，如交中以下，為陽曆；

translations.literal: Inspect the fixed entry-into-convergence day; at or below convergence middle, it is yang calendar;
translations.idiomatic: Inspect the fixed entry-into-convergence day; at or below convergence middle counts as yang calendar;

sentences.zh: 以上，去之，為陰曆。

translations.literal: above, remove it — yin calendar.
translations.idiomatic: above, subtract it — yin calendar.

sentences.zh: 如一日上下，以日法通日為分。

translations.literal: If about one day above or below, communicate the day by the day divisor into parts.
translations.idiomatic: If within about one day, convert the day through the day divisor into parts.

sentences.zh: 為交後分。

translations.literal: That is the after-convergence part.
translations.idiomatic: That is the after-convergence part.

sentences.zh: 十三日上下，覆減交中，為交前分。

translations.literal: If about thirteen days above or below, cover and subtract convergence middle — that is the before-convergence part.
translations.idiomatic: If within about thirteen days, cover and subtract convergence middle to obtain the before-convergence part.

sentences.zh: 求日月蝕其定餘

translations.literal: To find the fixed remainder for solar and lunar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: To find the fixed remainder for solar and lunar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 置朔、望入氣入轉朓棵定數，同名相從，異名相消，以一千三百三十七乘之，定朔、望加時入轉算外轉定分除之，所得，以朓減朒加經朔、望小餘，為泛餘。

translations.literal: Set the new- and full-moon entry-into-qi and entry-into-rotation tiao–chuo fixed numbers; of the same name follow together, of different name cancel; multiply by 1,337; divide by the fixed new- and full-moon hour-of-addition entry-into-rotation count-outside rotation fixed parts; with the result tiao subtract and chuo add to the canonical new- and full-moon minor remainder — that is the general remainder.
translations.idiomatic: Set the new- and full-moon entry-into-qi and entry-into-rotation tiao–chuo fixed numbers, combine same names and cancel different names, multiply by 1,337, divide by the fixed syzygy hour's entry-into-rotation count-outside rotation fixed parts, apply tiao subtract and chuo add to the canonical new- and full-moon minor remainder, and obtain the general remainder.

sentences.zh: 日蝕：視泛餘如半法以下，為中前分；

translations.literal: Solar eclipse: inspect the general remainder; at or below the half method, it is the before-middle part;
translations.idiomatic: Solar eclipse: if the general remainder is at or below the half method, it is the before-middle part;

sentences.zh: 半法以上，去半法，為中後分。

translations.literal: at or above the half method, remove the half method — that is the after-middle part.
translations.idiomatic: at or above the half method, subtract the half method for the after-middle part.

sentences.zh: 置中前後分，與半法相減相乘，倍之，萬約為分，曰時差。

translations.literal: Set the before- and after-middle parts; subtract and multiply against the half method, double, reduce by 10,000 for parts — call this time difference.
translations.idiomatic: Set the before- and after-middle parts, subtract and multiply against the half method, double, and reduce by 10,000 to obtain the time difference.

sentences.zh: 中前，以時差減泛余為定餘，覆減半法，餘為午前分。

translations.literal: Before middle: subtract the time difference from the general remainder for the fixed remainder; cover and subtract the half method — the remainder is the before-noon part.
translations.idiomatic: Before middle: subtract the time difference from the general remainder for the fixed remainder; cover and subtract the half method — the remainder is the before-noon part.

sentences.zh: 中後，以時差加泛為定餘，減去半法，為午後分。

translations.literal: After middle: add the time difference to the general remainder for the fixed remainder; subtract the half method — that is the after-noon part.
translations.idiomatic: After middle: add the time difference to the general remainder for the fixed remainder and subtract the half method to obtain the after-noon part.

sentences.zh: 月食：視泛餘在日入後、夜半前者，如日法四分之三以下，減去半法，為酉前分；

translations.literal: Lunar eclipse: inspect the general remainder after sunset and before midnight; at or below three-quarters of the day divisor, subtract the half method — that is the before-you part;
translations.idiomatic: Lunar eclipse: if the general remainder falls after sunset and before midnight, at or below three-quarters of the day divisor subtract the half method for the before-you part;

sentences.zh: 四分之三以上，覆減日法，餘為酉後分，又視泛餘在夜半後、日出前者，如日法四分之一以下，為卯前分，四分之一以上，覆減半法，餘為卯後分。

translations.literal: at or above three-quarters, cover and subtract the day divisor — the remainder is the after-you part; again inspect the general remainder after midnight and before sunrise: at or below one-quarter of the day divisor, it is the before-mao part; at or above one-quarter, cover and subtract the half method — the remainder is the after-mao part.
translations.idiomatic: above three-quarters, cover and subtract the day divisor for the after-you part; if after midnight and before sunrise, at or below one-quarter of the day divisor counts as before-mao, and above one-quarter cover and subtract the half method for after-mao.

sentences.zh: 其卯酉前後分，自相乘。

translations.literal: For the before- and after-mao and before- and after-you parts, self-multiply each.
translations.idiomatic: Self-multiply each of the before- and after-mao and before- and after-you parts.

sentences.zh: 四因，退位，萬約為分，以加泛餘，為定餘。

translations.literal: Multiply by four, step back one place, reduce by 10,000 for parts, and add to the general remainder — that is the fixed remainder.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply by four, shift one place back, reduce by 10,000 for parts, add to the general remainder, and obtain the fixed remainder.

sentences.zh: 各置定餘，以發斂加時法求之，即得日月所蝕之辰刻。

translations.literal: Set each fixed remainder and seek with the aggregation-and-release hour-of-addition method — that is the double-hour and ke when sun and moon are eclipsed.
translations.idiomatic: Set each fixed remainder and apply the aggregation-and-release hour-of-addition method to obtain the double-hour and ke of the eclipse.

sentences.zh: 求日月食甚日行積度

translations.literal: To find solar and lunar eclipse-greatest daily solar motion accumulated degree.
translations.idiomatic: To find the solar motion accumulated degree at eclipse greatest.

sentences.zh: 置定朔、望食甚大小餘，與經朔、望大小餘相減之餘，以加減經朔、望入氣日小餘，經朔、望日少加多減。

translations.literal: Set the fixed new- and full-moon eclipse-greatest major and minor remainders; the remainder of subtracting the canonical new- and full-moon major and minor remainders is used to add and subtract the canonical new- and full-moon entry-into-qi day minor remainder — canonical new and full moon: when the day is less, add more and subtract less.
translations.idiomatic: Set the fixed syzygy eclipse-greatest major and minor remainders, subtract the canonical syzygy major and minor remainders, and with the difference adjust the canonical syzygy entry-into-qi day minor remainder (when the day count is less, add more and subtract less).

sentences.zh: 即為食甚入氣。

translations.literal: That is entry into qi at eclipse greatest.
translations.idiomatic: That is the entry into qi at eclipse greatest.

sentences.zh: 以加其氣中積，為食甚中積。

translations.literal: Add to its qi mid-accumulation — that is the mid-accumulation at eclipse greatest.
translations.idiomatic: Add that to the qi mid-accumulation to obtain the mid-accumulation at eclipse greatest.

sentences.zh: 又置食甚入氣小餘，以所入氣日損益率盈縮之損益乘之，日法而一，以損益其日盈縮積；

translations.literal: Again set the entry-into-qi minor remainder at eclipse greatest; multiply by that qi day's gain-and-loss rate of excess-and-deficit adjustment, divide by the day divisor, and with that add or subtract that day's excess-and-deficit accumulation;
translations.idiomatic: Set the entry-into-qi minor remainder at eclipse greatest, multiply by that qi day's excess-and-deficit gain-and-loss rate, divide by the day divisor, and adjust that day's excess-and-deficit accumulation;

sentences.zh: 盈加縮減食甚中積，即為食甚日行積度及分。

translations.literal: excess adds and deficit subtracts from the eclipse-greatest mid-accumulation — that is the eclipse-greatest daily solar motion accumulated degree and parts.
translations.idiomatic: excess adds and deficit subtracts from the eclipse-greatest mid-accumulation to obtain the eclipse-greatest daily solar motion accumulated degree and parts.

sentences.zh: 求氣差

translations.literal: To find qi difference.
translations.idiomatic: To find qi difference.

sentences.zh: 置日食甚日行積度及分，滿中限去之，餘在象限以下，為初限；

translations.literal: Set the solar eclipse-greatest daily solar motion accumulated degree and parts; remove by the central limit; if the remainder is at or below the image limit, it is the initial limit;
translations.idiomatic: Set the solar eclipse-greatest daily solar motion accumulated degree and parts, cast out the central limit, and if the remainder is at or below the image limit it is the initial limit;

sentences.zh: 以上，覆減中限，為末限，皆有相乘，進二位，如四百七十八而一，所得，用減一千七百四十四，餘為氣差恆數。

translations.literal: if above, cover and subtract the central limit for the final limit; in each case subtract and multiply, advance two places, divide by 478; with the result subtract from 1,744 — the remainder is the qi-difference constant.
translations.idiomatic: if above, cover and subtract the central limit for the final limit; subtract and multiply in each case, shift two places, divide by 478, subtract from 1,744, and obtain the qi-difference constant.

sentences.zh: 以午前後分乘之，半晝分除之，所得，以減恆數為定數。

translations.literal: Multiply by the before- or after-noon part and divide by half the day-length part; with the result subtract from the constant — that is the fixed number.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply by the before- or after-noon part, divide by half the day-length part, subtract from the constant, and obtain the fixed number.

sentences.zh: 不及減，覆減之，為定數。

translations.literal: If it cannot be subtracted, cover and subtract — that is the fixed number.
translations.idiomatic: If subtraction fails, cover and subtract instead to obtain the fixed number.

sentences.zh: 應加者減之，減者加之。

translations.literal: Where it should add, subtract; where it should subtract, add.
translations.idiomatic: Where addition is indicated, subtract; where subtraction is indicated, add.

sentences.zh: 春分後，陽曆減，陰曆加；

translations.literal: After the spring equinox, yang calendar subtracts and yin calendar adds;
translations.idiomatic: After the spring equinox, yang calendar subtracts and yin calendar adds;

sentences.zh: 秋分後，陽曆加，陰曆減。

translations.literal: after the autumn equinox, yang calendar adds and yin calendar subtracts.
translations.idiomatic: after the autumn equinox, yang calendar adds and yin calendar subtracts.

sentences.zh: 春分前、秋分後各二日二千一百分為定氣，於此加減之。

translations.literal: Before the spring equinox and after the autumn equinox, two days and 2,100 parts each are the fixed qi; apply the addition and subtraction within this.
translations.idiomatic: Before the spring equinox and after the autumn equinox, treat two days and 2,100 parts each as fixed qi and apply these additions and subtractions within that interval.

sentences.zh: 求刻差

translations.literal: To find ke difference.
translations.idiomatic: To find ke difference.

sentences.zh: 置日食甚日行積度及分，滿中限去之，餘與中限相減相乘，進二位，如四百七十八而一，所得，為刻差恆數。

translations.literal: Set the solar-eclipse-greatest solar daily accumulated degree and parts; when full discard the middle limit; with the remainder multiply the difference from the middle limit, advance two places, divide by 478 — the result is the quarter-mark difference constant.
translations.idiomatic: Set the solar-eclipse-greatest solar daily accumulated degree and parts, discard full middle limits, multiply the remainder by its distance from the middle limit, advance two places, divide by 478, and obtain the quarter-mark difference constant.

sentences.zh: 以午前後分乘之，日法四分之一除之，所得為定數。

translations.literal: Multiply by the before- and after-noon parts; divide by one quarter of the day divisor — the result is the fixed number.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply by the before- and after-noon parts and divide by one quarter of the day divisor to obtain the fixed number.

sentences.zh: 若在恆數以上者，倍恆數，以所得數減之為定數，依其加減。

translations.literal: If above the constant, double the constant and subtract the obtained number for the fixed number; add or subtract accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: If above the constant, double the constant, subtract the obtained number for the fixed number, and apply the indicated additions or subtractions.

sentences.zh: 冬至後，午前陽加陰減，午後陽減陰加。

translations.literal: After winter solstice, before noon: yang add, yin subtract; after noon: yang subtract, yin add.
translations.idiomatic: After winter solstice, before noon add in the yang case and subtract in the yin case; after noon subtract in the yang case and add in the yin case.

sentences.zh: 夏至後，午前陽減陰加，午後陽加陰減。

translations.literal: After summer solstice, before noon: yang subtract, yin add; after noon: yang add, yin subtract.
translations.idiomatic: After summer solstice, before noon subtract in the yang case and add in the yin case; after noon add in the yang case and subtract in the yin case.

sentences.zh: 求日食去前後定分

translations.literal: To find the solar eclipse fixed distance from crossing before and after.
translations.idiomatic: To find the solar eclipse fixed distance from crossing before and after.

sentences.zh: 氣刻二差定數，同名相從，異名相消，為食差。

translations.literal: The qi and quarter-mark two-difference fixed numbers: same name combine, different name cancel — this is the eclipse difference.
translations.idiomatic: Combine the qi- and quarter-mark-difference fixed numbers of the same name and cancel those of different name to obtain the eclipse difference.

sentences.zh: 依其加減去交前後分，為去交前後定分。

translations.literal: According to their additions and subtractions remove from the crossing before-and-after parts — these are the fixed crossing before-and-after parts.
translations.idiomatic: Apply the additions and subtractions to the crossing before-and-after parts to obtain the fixed crossing before-and-after parts.

sentences.zh: 視其前後定分，如在陽曆，即不食；

translations.literal: View the before-and-after fixed parts: if in the yang lunation, then no eclipse;
translations.idiomatic: Inspect the before-and-after fixed parts: in the yang lunation there is no eclipse;

sentences.zh: 如在陰曆，即有食之。

translations.literal: if in the yin lunation, then there is an eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: in the yin lunation there is an eclipse.

sentences.zh: 如交前陰曆不及減，反減之，反減食差。

translations.literal: If before crossing in the yin lunation it is insufficient to subtract, reverse the subtraction and reverse-subtract the eclipse difference.
translations.idiomatic: If before crossing in the yin lunation subtraction is insufficient, reverse the subtraction and reverse-subtract the eclipse difference.

sentences.zh: 為交後陽曆；

translations.literal: that becomes after-crossing yang lunation;
translations.idiomatic: that becomes after-crossing yang lunation;

sentences.zh: 交後陰曆不及減，反減之，為交前陽曆；

translations.literal: if after crossing in the yin lunation it is insufficient to subtract, reverse the subtraction — that is before-crossing yang lunation;
translations.idiomatic: if after crossing in the yin lunation subtraction is insufficient, reverse the subtraction to obtain before-crossing yang lunation;

sentences.zh: 即不食，交前陽曆不及減，反減之，為交後陰曆；

translations.literal: then no eclipse; if before crossing in the yang lunation it is insufficient to subtract, reverse the subtraction — that is after-crossing yin lunation;
translations.idiomatic: then there is no eclipse; if before crossing in the yang lunation subtraction is insufficient, reverse the subtraction to obtain after-crossing yin lunation;

sentences.zh: 交後陽曆，不及減，反減之，為交前陰曆；

translations.literal: if after crossing in the yang lunation it is insufficient to subtract, reverse the subtraction — that is before-crossing yin lunation;
translations.idiomatic: if after crossing in the yang lunation subtraction is insufficient, reverse the subtraction to obtain before-crossing yin lunation;

sentences.zh: 即日有食之。

translations.literal: then that day there is a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: then that day there is a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 求日食分

translations.literal: To find the solar eclipse parts.
translations.idiomatic: To find the solar eclipse parts.

sentences.zh: 視去交前後定分，如二千四百以下，為既前分，以二百四十八除為大分。

translations.literal: View the fixed crossing before-and-after parts: if 2,400 or below, these are before-totality parts; divide by 248 for great parts.
translations.idiomatic: Inspect the fixed crossing before-and-after parts: at 2,400 or below take before-totality parts and divide by 248 for great parts.

sentences.zh: 二千四百以上，覆減五千五百，不足減者不食。

translations.literal: If 2,400 or above, cover and subtract 5,500; if insufficient to subtract, there is no eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: If 2,400 or above, cover and subtract 5,500; if subtraction is insufficient, there is no eclipse.

sentences.zh: 為既後分，以三百二十除為大分。

translations.literal: These are after-totality parts; divide by 320 for great parts.
translations.idiomatic: These are after-totality parts; divide by 320 for great parts.

sentences.zh: 不盡，退除為秒，即得日食之分秒。

translations.literal: What does not exhaust, retreat and divide for seconds — that yields the solar eclipse parts and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Convert any remainder by retreating and dividing for seconds to obtain the solar eclipse parts and seconds.

sentences.zh: 求月食分

translations.literal: To find the lunar eclipse parts.
translations.idiomatic: To find the lunar eclipse parts.

sentences.zh: 視去交前後分，不用氣刻差者。

translations.literal: View the crossing before-and-after parts; do not use the qi and quarter-mark differences.
translations.idiomatic: Use the crossing before-and-after parts without the qi and quarter-mark differences.

sentences.zh: 一千七百以下者，食既。

translations.literal: If 1,700 or below, the eclipse is total.
translations.idiomatic: At 1,700 or below the eclipse is total.

sentences.zh: 以上，覆減五千一百，不足減者不食。

translations.literal: If above, cover and subtract 5,100; if insufficient to subtract, there is no eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: If above, cover and subtract 5,100; if subtraction is insufficient, there is no eclipse.

sentences.zh: 餘以三百四十除為大分，不盡，退除為秒，即為月食之分秒也。

translations.literal: With the remainder divide by 340 for great parts; what does not exhaust, retreat and divide for seconds — these are the lunar eclipse parts and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Divide the remainder by 340 for great parts, convert any remainder into seconds, and obtain the lunar eclipse parts and seconds.

sentences.zh: 去交分在既限以下，覆減既限，亦以三百四十除，為既內之大分。

translations.literal: If the distance-from-crossing parts are at or below the totality limit, cover and subtract the totality limit and likewise divide by 340 — these are the great parts within totality.
translations.idiomatic: If the distance-from-crossing parts are at or below the totality limit, cover and subtract the totality limit and likewise divide by 340 for the great parts within totality.

sentences.zh: 求日食定用分

translations.literal: To find the solar eclipse fixed usage parts.
translations.idiomatic: To find the solar eclipse fixed usage parts.

sentences.zh: 置日食之大分，與三十分相減相乘，又以二千四百五十乘之，如定朔入轉算外轉定分而一，所得，為定用分。

translations.literal: Set the solar eclipse great parts; subtract and multiply with 30 parts; multiply again by 2,450; divide by the fixed new moon's entry-into-rotation outside rotation fixed parts — the result is the fixed usage parts.
translations.idiomatic: Set the solar eclipse great parts, subtract and multiply with 30 parts, multiply by 2,450, divide by the fixed new moon's outside-rotation fixed parts, and obtain the fixed usage parts.

sentences.zh: 減定余，為初虧分。

translations.literal: Subtract from the fixed remainder — these are the first-diminishment parts.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract from the fixed remainder to obtain the first-diminishment parts.

sentences.zh: 加定餘，為複圓分。

translations.literal: Add to the fixed remainder — these are the restoration-of-roundness parts.
translations.idiomatic: Add to the fixed remainder to obtain the restoration-of-roundness parts.

sentences.zh: 各以發斂加時法求之，即得日食三限辰刻。

translations.literal: For each, use the expansion-contraction hour-addition method to find them — that yields the solar eclipse's three-limit chen and ke.
translations.idiomatic: Apply the expansion-contraction hour-addition method to each to obtain the solar eclipse's three-limit chen and ke.

sentences.zh: 求月食定用分

translations.literal: To find the lunar eclipse fixed usage parts.
translations.idiomatic: To find the lunar eclipse fixed usage parts.

sentences.zh: 置月食之大分，與三十分相減相乘，又以二千一百乘之，如定望入轉算外轉定分而一，所得，為定用分。

translations.literal: Set the lunar eclipse great parts; subtract and multiply with 30 parts; multiply again by 2,100; divide by the fixed full moon's entry-into-rotation outside rotation fixed parts — the result is the fixed usage parts.
translations.idiomatic: Set the lunar eclipse great parts, subtract and multiply with 30 parts, multiply by 2,100, divide by the fixed full moon's outside-rotation fixed parts, and obtain the fixed usage parts.

sentences.zh: 加減定余，為初虧、複圓分。

translations.literal: Add and subtract the fixed remainder — these are the first-diminishment and restoration-of-roundness parts.
translations.idiomatic: Add and subtract the fixed remainder to obtain the first-diminishment and restoration-of-roundness parts.

sentences.zh: 各如發斂加時法求之，即得月食三限辰刻。

translations.literal: For each as the expansion-contraction hour-addition method to find them — that yields the lunar eclipse's three-limit chen and ke.
translations.idiomatic: Apply the expansion-contraction hour-addition method to each to obtain the lunar eclipse's three-limit chen and ke.

sentences.zh: 月食既者，以既內大分與十五相減相乘，又以四千二百乘之，如定望入轉算外轉定分而一，所得，為既內分。

translations.literal: When the lunar eclipse is total, take the within-totality great parts, subtract and multiply with 15, multiply again by 4,200, divide by the fixed full moon's entry-into-rotation outside rotation fixed parts — the result is the within-totality parts.
translations.idiomatic: For a total lunar eclipse, take the within-totality great parts, subtract and multiply with 15, multiply by 4,200, divide by the fixed full moon's outside-rotation fixed parts, and obtain the within-totality parts.

sentences.zh: 用減定用分，為既外分。

translations.literal: Subtract these from the fixed usage parts — these are the outside-totality parts.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract these from the fixed usage parts to obtain the outside-totality parts.

sentences.zh: 置月食餘減定用分，為初虧。

translations.literal: Set the lunar eclipse remainder and subtract the fixed usage parts — this is first diminishment.
translations.idiomatic: Set the lunar eclipse remainder, subtract the fixed usage parts, and obtain first diminishment.

sentences.zh: 因加既外分，為食既。

translations.literal: Then add the outside-totality parts — this is eclipse totality.
translations.idiomatic: Then add the outside-totality parts to obtain eclipse totality.

sentences.zh: 又加既內分，為食甚。

translations.literal: Again add the within-totality parts — this is greatest eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Again add the within-totality parts to obtain greatest eclipse.

sentences.zh: 既定餘分也。

translations.literal: It is already the fixed remainder parts.
translations.idiomatic: This is already the fixed remainder parts.

sentences.zh: 再加既內分，為生光。

translations.literal: Again add the within-totality parts — this is light generation.
translations.idiomatic: Again add the within-totality parts to obtain light generation.

sentences.zh: 複加既外分，為複圓。

translations.literal: Again add the outside-totality parts — this is restoration of roundness.
translations.idiomatic: Again add the outside-totality parts to obtain restoration of roundness.

sentences.zh: 各以發斂加時法求之，既得月食五限辰刻。

translations.literal: For each use the expansion-contraction hour-addition method to find them — one then has the lunar eclipse's five-limit chen and ke.
translations.idiomatic: Apply the expansion-contraction hour-addition method to each to obtain the lunar eclipse's five-limit chen and ke.

sentences.zh: 求月食入更點

translations.literal: To find the lunar eclipse's entry into watch and point.
translations.idiomatic: To find the lunar eclipse's entry into watch and point.

sentences.zh: 置食甚所入日晨分，倍之，五約為更法。

translations.literal: Set the day's dawn parts at greatest eclipse, double them, and five-reduce to make the watch method.
translations.idiomatic: Set the day's dawn parts at greatest eclipse, double them, and five-reduce to obtain the watch method.

sentences.zh: 又五約更法，為點法。

translations.literal: Again five-reduce the watch method to make the point method.
translations.idiomatic: Again five-reduce the watch method to obtain the point method.

sentences.zh: 乃置月食初末諸分，昏分以上減昏分，晨分以下加晨分。

translations.literal: Then set the lunar eclipse's beginning-and-end various parts: above dusk parts subtract dusk parts; below dawn parts add dawn parts.
translations.idiomatic: Then set the lunar eclipse's beginning-and-end parts: above dusk parts subtract dusk parts; below dawn parts add dawn parts.

sentences.zh: 如不滿更法為初更。

translations.literal: If insufficient for the watch method, that is the first watch.
translations.idiomatic: If insufficient for the watch method, that is the first watch.

sentences.zh: 不滿點法為一點。

translations.literal: What does not fill the point divisor is one point.
translations.idiomatic: Any remainder short of the point divisor counts as one point.

sentences.zh: 依法以次求之，既各得更點數。

translations.literal: By the method seek each in sequence; then each obtains its geng and point numbers.
translations.idiomatic: Apply the method in order to each limit; each then yields its geng and point counts.

sentences.zh: 求日食所起

translations.literal: To find where the solar eclipse begins.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to find the solar eclipse’s direction of first contact.

sentences.zh: 食在既前，初起西南，甚于正南，複于東南；

translations.literal: When the eclipse is before completion: first contact in the southwest, maximum due south, recovery in the southeast;
translations.idiomatic: Before full obscuration, first contact lies southwest, maximum due south, and recovery southeast;

sentences.zh: 食在既後，初起西北，甚於正北，複于東北。

translations.literal: When the eclipse is after completion: first contact in the northwest, maximum due north, recovery in the northeast.
translations.idiomatic: After full obscuration, first contact lies northwest, maximum due north, and recovery northeast.

sentences.zh: 其食八分以上，皆起正西，複於正東。

translations.literal: When the eclipse is eight-tenths or more, all begin due west and recover due east.
translations.idiomatic: For eclipses of eight-tenths or greater, first contact is always due west and recovery due east.

sentences.zh: 此據正午地而論之。

translations.literal: This is discussed with reference to a location at the meridian (noon).
translations.idiomatic: This assumes an observer on the local meridian (at noon).

sentences.zh: 求月食所起

translations.literal: To find where the lunar eclipse begins.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to find the lunar eclipse’s direction of first contact.

sentences.zh: 月在陽曆：初起東北，甚於正北，複於西北。

translations.literal: When the moon is in the yang half of the month: first contact in the northeast, maximum due north, recovery in the northwest.
translations.idiomatic: With the moon in the yang half of the nodal month, first contact is northeast, maximum due north, and recovery northwest.

sentences.zh: 月在陰曆：初起東南，甚于正南，複於西南。

translations.literal: When the moon is in the yin half of the month: first contact in the southeast, maximum due south, recovery in the southwest.
translations.idiomatic: With the moon in the yin half of the nodal month, first contact is southeast, maximum due south, and recovery southwest.

sentences.zh: 其食八分以上，皆起正東，複於正西。

translations.literal: When the eclipse is eight-tenths or more, all begin due east and recover due west.
translations.idiomatic: For eclipses of eight-tenths or greater, first contact is always due east and recovery due west.

sentences.zh: 此亦據午地而論之

translations.literal: This too is discussed with reference to a meridian location.
translations.idiomatic: This likewise assumes an observer on the local meridian.

sentences.zh: 求日食出入帶食所見分數

translations.literal: To find the fraction of solar eclipse visible at sunrise or sunset with partial horizon eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to find the fraction of a solar eclipse visible when it is caught at sunrise or sunset (horizon partial eclipse).

sentences.zh: 各以食甚小餘，與日出入分相減，餘為帶食差，以乘所食之分，滿定用分而一，月食既者，以既內分減帶食差，餘乘所食分，如既外分而一。

translations.literal: For each, set the eclipse-maximum minor remainder and subtract the sun’s rise-or-set parts; the remainder is the horizon-partial-eclipse difference; multiply by the fraction eclipsed and divide by the fixed application parts for one; for a total lunar eclipse, subtract the within-totality parts from the horizon-partial-eclipse difference, multiply the remainder by the fraction eclipsed, and divide by the outside-totality parts for one.
translations.idiomatic: For each case, subtract the sun’s rise-or-set parts from the eclipse-maximum minor remainder to get the horizon-partial difference; multiply by the eclipsed fraction and divide by the fixed application parts; for total lunar eclipse, subtract the within-totality parts from that difference, multiply the remainder by the eclipsed fraction, and divide by the outside-totality parts.

sentences.zh: 不及減者，為帶食既出入。

translations.literal: When it cannot be fully subtracted, it is partial totality at rise or set.
translations.idiomatic: If the subtraction cannot be completed, the eclipse is partially total at rise or set.

sentences.zh: 以減所食分，即日月出入帶食所見之分。

translations.literal: Subtract that from the eclipsed fraction — that is the fraction of sun or moon visible at rise or set with horizon partial eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the result from the eclipsed fraction to obtain the visible fraction at rise or set for sun or moon with horizon partial eclipse.

sentences.zh: 其食甚在晝，晨為漸進，昏為已退。

translations.literal: When eclipse maximum falls in daytime, dawn means still advancing and dusk means already retreating.
translations.idiomatic: If greatest eclipse is in daylight, at dawn the eclipse is still advancing and at dusk it has already retreated.

sentences.zh: 食甚在夜，晨為已退，昏為漸進。

translations.literal: When eclipse maximum falls at night, dawn means already retreating and dusk means still advancing.
translations.idiomatic: If greatest eclipse is at night, at dawn it has already retreated and at dusk it is still advancing.

sentences.zh: 求日月食甚宿次

translations.literal: To find the lodge position at sun or moon eclipse maximum.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to find the lodge at solar or lunar eclipse maximum.

sentences.zh: 置日月食甚日行積度，望即更加半周天。

translations.literal: Set the sun or moon eclipse-maximum daily-motion accumulated degrees; at full moon add half a circuit of heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Set the daily-motion accumulated degrees at eclipse maximum for sun or moon; at full moon add half a circuit of heaven.

sentences.zh: 以天正冬至加時黃道日度，加而命之，依黃道宿次去之，即各得日月食甚宿度及分。

translations.literal: Add to the ecliptic solar degree at civil new-year winter solstice hour-of-addition, add and name, remove by the ecliptic lodge sequence — that yields each sun or moon eclipse-maximum lodge degree and parts.
translations.idiomatic: Add to the winter solstice ecliptic solar degree at hour-of-addition, name the lodges, and remove by the ecliptic lodge sequence to obtain each eclipse-maximum lodge degree and parts for sun or moon.
