sentences.zh: 求五星天正冬至後平合及諸段中積中星

translations.literal: To find the five planets' mean conjunction after heavenly-origin winter solstice and the central accumulation and central star of each segment.
translations.idiomatic: To find each planet's mean conjunction after heavenly-origin winter solstice and the central accumulation and central star for every segment.

sentences.zh: 置通積分，各以其星周率去之。

translations.literal: Set the comprehensive accumulated parts; for each, discard by that star's circuit rate.
translations.idiomatic: Set the comprehensive accumulated parts and, for each star, cast out full circuit rates.

sentences.zh: 不盡，為前合分。

translations.literal: What does not exhaust is the anterior conjunction parts.
translations.idiomatic: The remainder is the anterior conjunction parts.

sentences.zh: 覆減周率，餘為後合分。

translations.literal: Subtract the circuit rate again; the remainder is the posterior conjunction parts.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the circuit rate again; the remainder is the posterior conjunction parts.

sentences.zh: 如日法而一，不滿退除為分秒，即其星天正冬至後平合中積、中星。

translations.literal: Divide by the day divisor; what does not fill, reduce back for parts and seconds—that is the star's mean-conjunction central accumulation and central star after heavenly-origin winter solstice.
translations.idiomatic: Divide by the day divisor, reduce the remainder to parts and seconds, and obtain that star's mean-conjunction central accumulation and central star after heavenly-origin winter solstice.

sentences.zh: 命為日，曰中積。

translations.literal: Name as days—called central accumulation.
translations.idiomatic: Name the result as days—this is the central accumulation.

sentences.zh: 命為度，曰中星。

translations.literal: Name as degrees—called central star.
translations.idiomatic: Name the result as degrees—this is the central star.

sentences.zh: 以段日累加中積，即為諸段中積。

translations.literal: Accumulate segment days to the central accumulation to obtain each segment's central accumulation.
translations.idiomatic: Add segment days cumulatively to the central accumulation to obtain each segment's central accumulation.

sentences.zh: 以平度累加中星，經退減之，即為諸段中星。

translations.literal: Accumulate mean degrees to the central star, casting back when full, to obtain each segment's central star.
translations.idiomatic: Add mean degrees cumulatively to the central star, casting back when full, to obtain each segment's central star.

sentences.zh: 求五星平合及諸段入曆

translations.literal: To find the five planets' mean conjunction and each segment's entry into the calendar cycle.
translations.idiomatic: To find each planet's mean conjunction and every segment's entry into the calendar cycle.

sentences.zh: 置前通積分，各加其星後合分，以曆率去之，不盡，各以其星曆度法除為度，不滿退為分秒，即為其星平合入曆度及分秒。

translations.literal: Set the anterior comprehensive accumulated parts; for each, add that star's posterior conjunction parts, discard by the calendar rate, and with what does not exhaust divide by that star's calendar degree divisor for degrees; what does not fill, reduce back for parts and seconds—that is the star's mean-conjunction entry-into-calendar degree and parts and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Set the anterior comprehensive accumulated parts, add each star's posterior conjunction parts, cast out full calendar rates, divide the remainder by that star's calendar degree divisor for degrees, reduce the remainder to parts and seconds, and obtain the mean-conjunction entry-into-calendar degree and parts and seconds.

sentences.zh: 以諸段限度累加之，即得諸段入曆。

translations.literal: Add each segment's limit degree cumulatively to obtain each segment's entry into the calendar cycle.
translations.idiomatic: Add each segment's limit degree cumulatively to obtain every segment's entry into the calendar cycle.

sentences.zh: 求五星平合及諸盈縮差

translations.literal: To find the five planets' mean conjunction and each segment's excess-and-deficit difference.
translations.idiomatic: To find each planet's mean conjunction and every segment's excess-and-deficit difference.

sentences.zh: 各置其星其段入曆度及分秒，如在曆中以下，為在盈；

translations.literal: For each, set that star and segment's entry-into-calendar degree and parts and seconds; if at or below the calendar middle, it is in excess;
translations.idiomatic: Set each star and segment's entry-into-calendar degree and parts and seconds; at or below the calendar middle counts as excess;

sentences.zh: 以上，減去曆中，餘為在縮。

translations.literal: if above, subtract the calendar middle; the remainder is in deficit.
translations.idiomatic: if above, subtract the calendar middle; the remainder is in deficit.

sentences.zh: 以其星曆策除之為策數，不盡為入策度及分，命策數算外，以其策數下損益率乘之，如曆策而一為分，以損益其下盈縮積度，即為其星其段盈縮定差。

translations.literal: Divide by that star's calendar policy for the policy count; what does not exhaust is the entry-into-policy degree and parts; name from outside the policy count, multiply the loss-and-gain rate below that policy count, divide by the calendar policy for parts, and apply it to the excess-and-deficit accumulated degree below—that is that star and segment's excess-and-deficit fixed difference.
translations.idiomatic: Divide by that star's calendar policy for the policy count, take the remainder as entry-into-policy degree and parts, name from outside the policy count, multiply the tabulated loss-and-gain rate, divide by the calendar policy for parts, apply it to the underlying excess-and-deficit accumulation, and obtain that star and segment's excess-and-deficit fixed difference.

sentences.zh: 求五星平合及諸段定積

translations.literal: To find the five planets' mean conjunction and each segment's fixed accumulation.
translations.idiomatic: To find each planet's mean conjunction and every segment's fixed accumulation.

sentences.zh: 各置其星其段中積，以其盈縮定差盈加減之。

translations.literal: For each, set that star and segment's central accumulation; add when in excess and subtract when in deficit by the excess-and-deficit fixed difference.
translations.idiomatic: Set each star and segment's central accumulation and add or subtract the excess-and-deficit fixed difference according to excess or deficit.

sentences.zh: 即其段定積日及分。

translations.literal: That yields the segment's fixed-accumulation days and parts.
translations.idiomatic: The result is the segment's fixed-accumulation days and parts.

sentences.zh: 以加天正冬至大餘及約分，滿紀法六十去之，不盡，即為定日及加時分秒。

translations.literal: Add to the heavenly-origin winter solstice greater remainder and approximate parts; when full, cast out the era rule of 60; what does not exhaust is the fixed day and hour-of-addition parts and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Add to the heavenly-origin winter solstice greater remainder and approximate parts, cast out full era rules of 60, and obtain the fixed day and hour-of-addition parts and seconds.

sentences.zh: 不滿命甲子算外，即得日辰。

translations.literal: When it does not fill, name from jiazi outside the count—that yields the day and double-hour.
translations.idiomatic: If it does not fill, name from jiazi outside the count to obtain the day and double-hour.

sentences.zh: 求五星及諸段所在日月

translations.literal: To find the sun and moon where each planet and segment falls.
translations.idiomatic: To find the sun and moon dates for each planet and segment.

sentences.zh: 各置其段定積日及分，以加天閏日及分，滿朔策及約分除之為月數，不盡，為入月已來日數及分。

translations.literal: For each, set that segment's fixed-accumulation days and parts, add the heavenly intercalary days and parts, and when full divide by the new-moon policy and approximate parts for month count; what does not exhaust is the days and parts elapsed within the month.
translations.idiomatic: Set each segment's fixed-accumulation days and parts, add heavenly intercalary days and parts, divide by the new-moon policy and approximate parts for month count, and take the remainder as days and parts elapsed within the month.

sentences.zh: 其月數命天正十一月算外，即得其段入月經朔日數及分，以日辰相距為所在定朔月日。

translations.literal: Name the month count from outside the count of heavenly-origin month eleven; that yields the segment's days and parts since the month's mean new moon; the interval of day and double-hour gives the fixed new-moon month and day where it falls.
translations.idiomatic: Name the month count from heavenly-origin month eleven outside the count, obtain the segment's days and parts since mean new moon, and take the day-and-double-hour interval as the fixed new-moon month and day.

sentences.zh: 求五星平合及諸段加時定星

translations.literal: To find the five planets' mean conjunction and each segment's hour-of-addition fixed star.
translations.idiomatic: To find each planet's mean conjunction and every segment's hour-of-addition fixed star.

sentences.zh: 各置中星，以盈縮定差盈加縮減之，金星倍之，水星三因之，然後加減。

translations.literal: For each, set the central star; when in excess add and when in deficit subtract the excess-and-deficit fixed difference—double for Venus, triple for Mercury—then add or subtract.
translations.idiomatic: Set each central star, apply the excess-and-deficit fixed difference (add in excess, subtract in deficit), double for Venus and triple for Mercury, then add or subtract.

sentences.zh: 即為五星諸段定星。

translations.literal: That is the five planets' fixed star for each segment.
translations.idiomatic: The result is each planet's fixed star for every segment.

sentences.zh: 以加天正冬至加時黃道日度，依宿命之，即其星其段加時所在宿度及分秒。

translations.literal: Add to the heavenly-origin winter solstice hour-of-addition ecliptic solar degree and name the lodge by fate—that is that star and segment's lodge degree and parts and seconds at hour of addition.
translations.idiomatic: Add to the heavenly-origin winter solstice ecliptic solar degree at hour of addition, name the lodge accordingly, and obtain that star and segment's lodge degree and parts and seconds at hour of addition.

sentences.zh: 求五星諸段初日晨前夜半定星

translations.literal: To find the five planets' fixed star at dawn before midnight on the first day of each segment.
translations.idiomatic: To find each planet's fixed star at dawn before midnight on the first day of each segment.

sentences.zh: 各以其段初行率，乘其段定積日下加時分，百約之，乃順減退加其日加時定星，即為其段初日晨前夜半定星所在宿度。

translations.literal: For each, multiply that segment's initial motion rate by the parts below the hour of addition on the segment's fixed-accumulation day, reduce by 100, then in forward motion subtract and in retrograde add to that day's hour-of-addition fixed star—that is the lodge degree where the segment-first-day dawn-before-midnight fixed star stands.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply each segment's initial motion rate by the hour-of-addition parts under the segment's fixed-accumulation day, reduce by 100, subtract in forward motion and add in retrograde to that day's hour-of-addition fixed star, and obtain the lodge degree of the segment-first-day dawn-before-midnight fixed star.

sentences.zh: 求諸段日率度率

translations.literal: To find each segment's day rate and degree rate.
translations.idiomatic: To find each segment's day rate and degree rate.

sentences.zh: 各以其段日辰距後段日辰為日率。

translations.literal: Each takes this segment's day-and-double-hour distance to the next segment's day-and-double-hour as the day rate.
translations.idiomatic: Take each segment's day-and-double-hour interval to the next segment as the day rate.

sentences.zh: 以其段夜半宿次與後段夜半宿次相減，餘為夜率。

translations.literal: Subtract this segment's midnight lodge sequence from the next segment's midnight lodge sequence; the remainder is the night rate.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract this segment's midnight lodge sequence from the next segment's; the remainder is the degree rate.

sentences.zh: 求諸段平行分

translations.literal: To find each segment's parallel motion parts.
translations.idiomatic: To find each segment's parallel motion parts.

sentences.zh: 各置其段度率及分秒，以其段日率除之，即其段平行度及分秒。

translations.literal: Set each segment's degree rate and parts and seconds; divide by that segment's day rate — that is that segment's parallel degree and parts and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Set each segment's degree rate and parts and seconds, divide by that segment's day rate, and obtain its parallel degree and parts and seconds.

sentences.zh: 求諸段總差日差

translations.literal: To find each segment's total difference and daily difference.
translations.idiomatic: To find each segment's total difference and daily difference.

sentences.zh: 以本段前後平行分相減，余為其段泛差。

translations.literal: Subtract this segment's prior and subsequent parallel motion parts; the remainder is this segment's general difference.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract this segment's prior and subsequent parallel motion parts; the remainder is its general difference.

sentences.zh: 假令求木星次疾*差，乃以順疾、順遲平行分相減，餘為次疾泛差。

translations.literal: Suppose one seeks Jupiter's second-fast difference: subtract the forward-swift and forward-slow parallel motion parts; the remainder is the second-fast general difference.
translations.idiomatic: To find Jupiter's second-fast difference, subtract forward-swift from forward-slow parallel motion parts; the remainder is the second-fast general difference.

sentences.zh: 他皆仿此。

translations.literal: All other cases follow this pattern.
translations.idiomatic: All other cases follow this pattern.

sentences.zh: 倍而退位為增減差，加減其段平行分，為初末日行分。

translations.literal: Double and shift back one place for the increase-decrease difference; add or subtract to this segment's parallel motion parts for initial and final day motion parts.
translations.idiomatic: Double the general difference and shift back one place for the increase-decrease difference, then add or subtract it from parallel motion parts to obtain initial and final day motion parts.

sentences.zh: 前多後少者，加為初，減為末。

translations.literal: If prior is more and subsequent less, add for initial and subtract for final.
translations.idiomatic: If the prior exceeds the subsequent, add for the initial day and subtract for the final day.

sentences.zh: 前少後多者，減為初，加為末。

translations.literal: If prior is less and subsequent more, subtract for initial and add for final.
translations.idiomatic: If the prior is less and the subsequent more, subtract for the initial day and add for the final day.

sentences.zh: 倍增減差為總差，以日率減一除之，為日差。

translations.literal: Double the increase-decrease difference for the total difference; divide by the day rate minus one for the daily difference.
translations.idiomatic: Double the increase-decrease difference for the total difference and divide by the day rate minus one to obtain the daily difference.

sentences.zh: 求前後伏遲退段增減差

translations.literal: To find the increase-decrease differences for prior and subsequent concealment, slow, and retrograde segments.
translations.idiomatic: To find the increase-decrease differences for prior and subsequent concealment, slow, and retrograde segments.

sentences.zh: 前伏者，置後段初日行分，加其日差之半，為末日行分。

translations.literal: For prior concealment: set the next segment's initial-day motion parts, add half its daily difference, for final-day motion parts.
translations.idiomatic: For prior concealment, set the next segment's initial-day motion parts, add half its daily difference, and obtain final-day motion parts.

sentences.zh: 後伏者，置前段末日行分，加其日差之半，為初日行分。

translations.literal: For subsequent concealment: set the prior segment's final-day motion parts, add half its daily difference, for initial-day motion parts.
translations.idiomatic: For subsequent concealment, set the prior segment's final-day motion parts, add half its daily difference, and obtain initial-day motion parts.

sentences.zh: 以減伏段平行分，餘為增減差。

translations.literal: Subtract from the concealment segment's parallel motion parts; the remainder is the increase-decrease difference.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract from the concealment segment's parallel motion parts; the remainder is the increase-decrease difference.

sentences.zh: 前遲者，置前段末日行分，倍其日差減之，為初日行分。

translations.literal: For prior slow: set the prior segment's final-day motion parts, subtract double its daily difference, for initial-day motion parts.
translations.idiomatic: For prior slow motion, set the prior segment's final-day motion parts, subtract double its daily difference, and obtain initial-day motion parts.

sentences.zh: 後遲者，置後段初日行分，倍其日差減之，為末日行分。

translations.literal: For subsequent slow: set the next segment's initial-day motion parts, subtract double its daily difference, for final-day motion parts.
translations.idiomatic: For subsequent slow motion, set the next segment's initial-day motion parts, subtract double its daily difference, and obtain final-day motion parts.

sentences.zh: 以遲段平行分減之，餘為增減差。

translations.literal: Subtract from the slow segment's parallel motion parts; the remainder is the increase-decrease difference.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract from the slow segment's parallel motion parts; the remainder is the increase-decrease difference.

sentences.zh: 前後近留之遲段。

translations.literal: Slow segments before and after that are near station.
translations.idiomatic: Slow segments before and after that lie near station.

sentences.zh: 木、火、土三星退行者，六因平行分，退一位，為增減差。

translations.literal: For Jupiter, Mars, and Saturn in retrograde: multiply parallel motion parts by six, shift back one place, for the increase-decrease difference.
translations.idiomatic: For Jupiter, Mars, and Saturn in retrograde, multiply parallel motion parts by six, shift back one place, and obtain the increase-decrease difference.

sentences.zh: 金星前後伏退，三因平行分，半而退位，為增減差。

translations.literal: For Venus in prior and subsequent concealment and retrograde: multiply parallel motion parts by three, halve and shift back one place, for the increase-decrease difference.
translations.idiomatic: For Venus at prior and subsequent concealment and retrograde, multiply parallel motion parts by three, halve and shift back one place, and obtain the increase-decrease difference.

sentences.zh: 前退者，置後段初日行分，以其日差減之，為末日行分，後退者，置前段末日行分，以其日差減之，為初日行分。

translations.literal: For prior retrograde: set the next segment's initial-day motion parts, subtract its daily difference, for final-day motion parts; for subsequent retrograde: set the prior segment's final-day motion parts, subtract its daily difference, for initial-day motion parts.
translations.idiomatic: For prior retrograde, set the next segment's initial-day motion parts, subtract its daily difference, and obtain final-day motion parts; for subsequent retrograde, set the prior segment's final-day motion parts, subtract its daily difference, and obtain initial-day motion parts.

sentences.zh: 以本段平行分減，餘為增減差。

translations.literal: Subtract from this segment's parallel motion parts; the remainder is the increase-decrease difference.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract from this segment's parallel motion parts; the remainder is the increase-decrease difference.

sentences.zh: 水星，半平行分為增減差，皆以增減差加減平行分，為初末日行分。

translations.literal: For Mercury, take half the parallel motion parts as the increase-decrease difference; in each case add or subtract the increase-decrease difference to parallel motion parts for initial and final day motion parts.
translations.idiomatic: For Mercury, take half the parallel motion parts as the increase-decrease difference, then add or subtract it from parallel motion parts to obtain initial and final day motion parts.

sentences.zh: 前多後少，加初減末；

translations.literal: If prior more and subsequent less: add for initial, subtract for final;
translations.idiomatic: If the prior exceeds the subsequent, add for the initial day and subtract for the final day;

sentences.zh: 前少後多，減初加末。

translations.literal: If prior less and subsequent more: subtract for initial, add for final.
translations.idiomatic: if the prior is less and the subsequent more, subtract for the initial day and add for the final day.

sentences.zh: 又倍增減差為總差，以日率減一除之，為日差。

translations.literal: Again double the increase-decrease difference for the total difference; divide by the day rate minus one for the daily difference.
translations.idiomatic: Again double the increase-decrease difference for the total difference and divide by the day rate minus one to obtain the daily difference.

sentences.zh: 求每日晨前夜半星行宿次

translations.literal: To find each day's star lodge sequence at dawn before midnight.
translations.idiomatic: To find each day's star lodge sequence at dawn before midnight.

sentences.zh: 各置其段初日行分，以日差累損益之後少則損之，後多則益之。

translations.literal: Set each segment's initial-day motion parts and accumulate additions and subtractions by the daily difference; if subsequent is less, subtract; if more, add.
translations.idiomatic: Set each segment's initial-day motion parts and apply the daily difference cumulatively; subtract when the subsequent value is less and add when it is more.

sentences.zh: 為每日行度及分秒。

translations.literal: This yields each day's motion degree and parts and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: The result is each day's motion in degrees, parts, and seconds.

sentences.zh: 乃順加退減之，滿宿次去之，即得每日晨前夜半星行宿次。

translations.literal: Then in forward motion add and in retrograde subtract, casting out full lodge sequences, and obtain each day's star lodge sequence at dawn before midnight.
translations.idiomatic: Then add in forward motion and subtract in retrograde, cast out full lodge sequences, and obtain each day's star lodge sequence at dawn before midnight.

sentences.zh: 視前段末日、後段初日行分相較之數，不過一二日差為妙。

translations.literal: Compare the prior segment's final day and next segment's initial day motion parts; a discrepancy of no more than one or two daily differences is best.
translations.idiomatic: Compare the prior segment's final-day and next segment's initial-day motion parts; a gap of no more than one or two daily differences is ideal.

sentences.zh: 或多日差數倍，或顛倒不倫，當類會前後增減差稍損益之，使其有倫，然後用之。

translations.literal: If the daily difference is several times too large or the sequence is inverted and disorderly, compare with prior and subsequent increase-decrease differences and adjust slightly until orderly, then use it.
translations.idiomatic: If the daily difference is many times too large or the sequence is inverted and incoherent, reconcile it with the surrounding increase-decrease differences, adjust slightly until coherent, and then apply it.

sentences.zh: 或前後平行俱多俱少，則平注之。

translations.literal: Or if prior and subsequent parallel motion are both too large or both too small, level them by equal distribution.
translations.idiomatic: If prior and subsequent parallel motion are both too large or both too small, distribute the correction evenly.

sentences.zh: 或總差之秒，不盈一分，亦平注之。

translations.literal: Or if the total difference's seconds do not fill one part, also level by equal distribution.
translations.idiomatic: If the total difference's seconds do not reach one part, distribute evenly as well.

sentences.zh: 若有不倫而平注之得倫者，亦平注之。

translations.literal: If disorderly but leveling yields order, level it.
translations.idiomatic: If the values are incoherent but even distribution restores coherence, distribute evenly.

sentences.zh: 求五星平合及見伏入氣

translations.literal: To find the five planets' mean conjunction and appearance and concealment entry into qi.
translations.idiomatic: To find each planet's mean conjunction and appearance-and-concealment entry into qi.

sentences.zh: 置定積，以氣策及約分除之，為氣數，不滿為入氣日及分秒，命天正冬至算外，即所求平合及伏見入氣日及分秒。

translations.literal: Set the fixed accumulation, divide by the qi divisor and approximate parts for qi count; what does not fill is days and parts and seconds entered into qi; name from heavenly-origin winter solstice outside the count — that is the sought mean conjunction and concealment and appearance entry-into-qi days and parts and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Set the fixed accumulation, divide by the qi divisor and approximate parts for the qi count, take the remainder as days, parts, and seconds entered into qi, name from heavenly-origin winter solstice outside the count, and obtain the mean conjunction and concealment-and-appearance entry-into-qi days, parts, and seconds.

sentences.zh: 求五星平合及見伏行差

translations.literal: To find the five planets' mean conjunction and appearance and concealment motion difference.
translations.idiomatic: To find each planet's mean conjunction and appearance-and-concealment motion difference.

sentences.zh: 各以其段初日星行分與其太陽行分相減，餘為行差。

translations.literal: Each takes this segment's initial-day star motion parts and subtracts the sun's motion parts; the remainder is the motion difference.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the sun's motion parts from each segment's initial-day star motion parts; the remainder is the motion difference.

sentences.zh: 若金在退行，水在退合者，相並為行差。

translations.literal: If Venus is in retrograde or Mercury in retrograde conjunction, combine for the motion difference.
translations.idiomatic: If Venus is retrograde or Mercury at retrograde conjunction, add the two for the motion difference.

sentences.zh: 如水星夕伏晨見者，直以太陽行分為行差。

translations.literal: As when Mercury is evening concealed and morning visible: use the sun's motion parts directly as the motion difference.
translations.idiomatic: When Mercury is evening concealed and morning visible, take the sun's motion parts directly as the motion difference.

sentences.zh: 求五星定合見伏泛積

translations.literal: To find the five planets' fixed conjunction, appearance, and concealment general accumulation.
translations.idiomatic: To find each planet's fixed conjunction, appearance, and concealment general accumulation.

sentences.zh: 木、火、土三星，各以平合晨疾夕伏定積，便為定合定見定伏泛積。

translations.literal: For Jupiter, Mars, and Saturn, each uses the mean-conjunction morning-swift evening-concealed fixed accumulation directly as the fixed conjunction, appearance, and concealment general accumulation.
translations.idiomatic: For Jupiter, Mars, and Saturn, the mean-conjunction morning-swift evening-concealed fixed accumulation is the fixed conjunction, appearance, and concealment general accumulation.

sentences.zh: 金、水二星，置其段盈縮差，水星倍之。

translations.literal: For Venus and Mercury, set that segment's excess-and-deficit difference; double for Mercury.
translations.idiomatic: For Venus and Mercury, set that segment's excess-and-deficit difference, doubling it for Mercury.

sentences.zh: 各以行差除之，為日，不滿退除為分秒。

translations.literal: Divide each by the motion difference for days; what does not fill, cast back for parts and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Divide each by the motion difference for days; reduce any remainder to parts and seconds.

sentences.zh: 若在平合夕見晨伏者，盈減縮加；

translations.literal: If at mean conjunction with evening visible and morning concealed: subtract in excess and add in deficit;
translations.idiomatic: At mean conjunction with evening visibility and morning concealment, subtract in excess and add in deficit;

sentences.zh: 如在退合夕伏晨見者，盈加縮減。

translations.literal: If at retrograde conjunction with evening concealed and morning visible: add in excess and subtract in deficit.
translations.idiomatic: At retrograde conjunction with evening concealment and morning visibility, add in excess and subtract in deficit.

sentences.zh: 皆以加減定積，為定合定見定伏泛積。

translations.literal: In every case add or subtract to the fixed accumulation to obtain the fixed conjunction, fixed appearance, and fixed hiding general accumulation.
translations.idiomatic: Apply the indicated additions and subtractions to the fixed accumulation to obtain the fixed conjunction, appearance, and hiding general accumulation.

sentences.zh: 求五星定合定積定星

translations.literal: To find the five planets' fixed conjunction fixed accumulation and fixed star.
translations.idiomatic: To find each planet's fixed conjunction fixed accumulation and fixed star.

sentences.zh: 木、火、土三星，各以平合行差除其日太陽盈縮差，為距合差日。

translations.literal: For Jupiter, Mars, and Saturn, each divide that day's solar excess-and-deficit difference by the mean-conjunction motion difference to obtain the conjunction-distance difference day.
translations.idiomatic: For Jupiter, Mars, and Saturn, divide each day's solar excess-and-deficit difference by the mean-conjunction motion difference to obtain the conjunction-distance difference day.

sentences.zh: 以太陽盈縮差減之，為距合差度。

translations.literal: Subtract it from the solar excess-and-deficit difference to obtain the conjunction-distance difference degree.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract from the solar excess-and-deficit difference to obtain the conjunction-distance difference degree.

sentences.zh: 日在盈曆，以差日差度減之。

translations.literal: When the sun is in the excess lunation, subtract the difference day and difference degree.
translations.idiomatic: When the sun is in the excess lunation, subtract the difference day and difference degree.

sentences.zh: 在縮，加之。

translations.literal: When in deficit, add them.
translations.idiomatic: When in deficit, add them.

sentences.zh: 加減其星定合泛積，為定合定積定星。

translations.literal: Add or subtract to that star's fixed-conjunction general accumulation to obtain the fixed conjunction fixed accumulation and fixed star.
translations.idiomatic: Add or subtract on that star's fixed-conjunction general accumulation to obtain the fixed conjunction fixed accumulation and fixed star.

sentences.zh: 金、水二星順合退合，各以平合退合行差除其日太陽盈縮差，為距合差日。

translations.literal: For Venus and Mercury in direct conjunction and retrograde conjunction, each divide that day's solar excess-and-deficit difference by the mean-conjunction or retrograde-conjunction motion difference to obtain the conjunction-distance difference day.
translations.idiomatic: For Venus and Mercury in direct or retrograde conjunction, divide that day's solar excess-and-deficit difference by the corresponding mean-conjunction motion difference to obtain the conjunction-distance difference day.

sentences.zh: 順加退減太陽盈縮差，為距合差度。

translations.literal: In direct motion add and in retrograde subtract the solar excess-and-deficit difference to obtain the conjunction-distance difference degree.
translations.idiomatic: Add the solar excess-and-deficit difference in direct motion and subtract it in retrograde motion to obtain the conjunction-distance difference degree.

sentences.zh: 順在盈曆，以差日差度加之；

translations.literal: In direct motion when in the excess lunation, add the difference day and difference degree;
translations.idiomatic: In direct motion when in the excess lunation, add the difference day and difference degree;

sentences.zh: 在縮，減之。

translations.literal: when in deficit, subtract them.
translations.idiomatic: when in deficit, subtract them.

sentences.zh: 退在盈曆，以差日減之，差度加之；

translations.literal: In retrograde motion when in the excess lunation, subtract the difference day and add the difference degree;
translations.idiomatic: In retrograde motion when in the excess lunation, subtract the difference day and add the difference degree;

sentences.zh: 在縮，以差日加之，差度減之。

translations.literal: when in deficit, add the difference day and subtract the difference degree.
translations.idiomatic: when in deficit, add the difference day and subtract the difference degree.

sentences.zh: 皆以加減其星定合及再定合泛積，為定合再定合定積定星。

translations.literal: In every case add or subtract to that star's fixed conjunction and second fixed-conjunction general accumulation to obtain the fixed conjunction, second fixed conjunction, fixed accumulation, and fixed star.
translations.idiomatic: Apply the indicated additions and subtractions to that star's fixed conjunction and second fixed-conjunction general accumulation to obtain the fixed conjunction, second fixed conjunction, fixed accumulation, and fixed star.

sentences.zh: 以冬至大餘及約分，加定積，滿紀法去，命，即得定合日辰。

translations.literal: Add the fixed accumulation to the winter solstice greater remainder and approximate parts, cast out full era rules, name accordingly, and obtain the fixed conjunction day and double-hour.
translations.idiomatic: Add the fixed accumulation to the winter solstice greater remainder and approximate parts, cast out full era rules, name the count, and obtain the fixed conjunction day and double-hour.

sentences.zh: 以冬至加時黃道日度，加定星，滿宿次去之，即得定合所在宿次。

translations.literal: Add the fixed star to the winter solstice hour-of-addition ecliptic solar degree, cast out full lodge sequences, and obtain the lodge where the fixed conjunction stands.
translations.idiomatic: Add the fixed star to the winter solstice ecliptic solar degree at hour of addition, remove full lodge sequences, and obtain the lodge of the fixed conjunction.

sentences.zh: 其順退所在盈縮，太陽盈縮也。

translations.literal: Whether direct or retrograde, the excess or deficit applied is the solar excess and deficit.
translations.idiomatic: Whether the motion is direct or retrograde, the excess or deficit used is the sun's excess and deficit.

sentences.zh: 求木水土三星定見伏定積日

translations.literal: To find Jupiter, Mars, and Saturn's fixed appearance, hiding, and fixed-accumulation days.
translations.idiomatic: To find the fixed appearance, hiding, and fixed-accumulation days for Jupiter, Mars, and Saturn.

sentences.zh: 各置其星定見伏泛積，晨加夕減象限日及分秒，半中限為象限，如中限以下，自相乘，以上，覆減歲周日及分秒，餘亦自相乘，滿七十五而一，所得，以其星伏見度乘之，十五除之，為差。

translations.literal: For each, set that star's fixed appearance-and-hiding general accumulation; at dawn add and at dusk subtract the image-limit day and parts and seconds—half the middle limit serves as the image limit; if at or below the middle limit, square it; if above, overlay-subtract from the solar circuit day and parts and seconds, square the remainder likewise, divide by 75 for the obtained value, multiply by that star's heliacal appearance-and-hiding degree, divide by 15 for the difference.
translations.idiomatic: Set each star's fixed appearance-and-hiding general accumulation; at dawn add and at dusk subtract the image-limit day and parts and seconds, taking half the middle limit as the image limit; square values at or below the middle limit, and for values above overlay-subtract from the solar circuit day and parts and seconds and square the remainder; divide by 75, multiply by that star's heliacal appearance-and-hiding degree, and divide by 15 to obtain the difference.

sentences.zh: 其差如其段行差而一，為日，不滿退除為分秒。

translations.literal: Take the difference at one per that segment's motion difference for days; what does not fill, cast back for parts and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Divide the difference by that segment's motion difference for days; cast back the remainder into parts and seconds.

sentences.zh: 見加伏減泛積為定積。

translations.literal: At appearance add and at hiding subtract to the general accumulation to obtain the fixed accumulation.
translations.idiomatic: Add at appearance and subtract at hiding on the general accumulation to obtain the fixed accumulation.

sentences.zh: 加命如前，即得日辰也。

translations.literal: Add and name as before to obtain the day and double-hour.
translations.idiomatic: Add and name as before to obtain the day and double-hour.

sentences.zh: 求金水二星定見伏定積日

translations.literal: To find Venus and Mercury's fixed appearance, hiding, and fixed-accumulation days.
translations.idiomatic: To find the fixed appearance, hiding, and fixed-accumulation days for Venus and Mercury.

sentences.zh: 各以伏見日行差，除其日太陽盈縮差，為日。

translations.literal: For each, divide that day's solar excess-and-deficit difference by the appearance-hiding daily motion difference to obtain days.
translations.idiomatic: For each star, divide that day's solar excess-and-deficit difference by the appearance-hiding daily motion difference to obtain days.

sentences.zh: 若晨伏夕見，日在盈曆，加之，在縮，減之。

translations.literal: If morning hiding and evening appearance, when the sun is in the excess lunation add, when in deficit subtract.
translations.idiomatic: For morning hiding and evening appearance, add when the sun is in the excess lunation and subtract when in deficit.

sentences.zh: 如夕伏晨見，日在盈曆，減之，在縮，加之。

translations.literal: If evening hiding and morning appearance, when the sun is in the excess lunation subtract, when in deficit add.
translations.idiomatic: For evening hiding and morning appearance, subtract when the sun is in the excess lunation and add when in deficit.

sentences.zh: 加減其星泛積為常積。

translations.literal: Add or subtract to that star's general accumulation to obtain the regular accumulation.
translations.idiomatic: Add or subtract on that star's general accumulation to obtain the regular accumulation.

sentences.zh: 視常積，如中限以下，為冬至後，以上，去之，餘為夏至後。

translations.literal: View the regular accumulation: at or below the middle limit counts as after winter solstice; above, remove it and the remainder counts as after summer solstice.
translations.idiomatic: Inspect the regular accumulation: at or below the middle limit is after winter solstice; above it, cast out the middle limit and take the remainder as after summer solstice.

sentences.zh: 其二至後，如象限以下，自相乘，以上，覆減中限，亦自相乘，各如法而一，為分。

translations.literal: After each solstice, if at or below the image limit square it; if above, overlay-subtract from the middle limit and square the remainder likewise; in each case divide by the [appropriate] divisor for parts.
translations.idiomatic: After each solstice, square values at or below the image limit; above it, overlay-subtract from the middle limit and square the remainder; divide each by the appropriate divisor to obtain parts.

sentences.zh: 冬至後晨，夏至後夕，以一十八為法。

translations.literal: After winter solstice at dawn and after summer solstice at dusk, use 18 as the divisor.
translations.idiomatic: After winter solstice at dawn and after summer solstice at dusk, use 18 as the divisor.

sentences.zh: 冬至後夕，夏至後晨，以七十五為法。

translations.literal: After winter solstice at dusk and after summer solstice at dawn, use 75 as the divisor.
translations.idiomatic: After winter solstice at dusk and after summer solstice at dawn, use 75 as the divisor.

sentences.zh: 以伏見度乘之，十五除之，為差。

translations.literal: Multiply by the heliacal appearance-and-hiding degree and divide by 15 for the difference.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply by the heliacal appearance-and-hiding degree and divide by 15 to obtain the difference.

sentences.zh: 差滿行差而一，為日，不滿退除為分秒。

translations.literal: When the difference fills the motion difference, take one for days; what does not fill, cast back for parts and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: When the difference fills the motion difference, take one for days; cast back the remainder into parts and seconds.

sentences.zh: 加減常積為定積。

translations.literal: Add or subtract to the regular accumulation to obtain the fixed accumulation.
translations.idiomatic: Add or subtract on the regular accumulation to obtain the fixed accumulation.

sentences.zh: 冬至後晨見夕伏，加之；

translations.literal: After winter solstice, morning appearance and evening hiding: add;
translations.idiomatic: After winter solstice, for morning appearance and evening hiding, add;

sentences.zh: 夕見晨伏，減之。

translations.literal: evening appearance and morning hiding: subtract.
translations.idiomatic: for evening appearance and morning hiding, subtract.

sentences.zh: 夏至後晨見夕伏，減之；

translations.literal: After summer solstice, morning appearance and evening hiding: subtract;
translations.idiomatic: After summer solstice, for morning appearance and evening hiding, subtract;

sentences.zh: 夕見晨伏，加之也。

translations.literal: evening appearance and morning hiding: add.
translations.idiomatic: for evening appearance and morning hiding, add.

sentences.zh: 加命如前，即得定見伏日辰。

translations.literal: Add and name as before to obtain the fixed appearance-and-hiding day and double-hour.
translations.idiomatic: Add and name as before to obtain the fixed appearance-and-hiding day and double-hour.

sentences.zh: 其水星，夕疾，在大暑氣初日至立冬氣九日三十五分以下者，不見。

translations.literal: For Mercury, when in evening swift motion from the start of Great Heat qi through the ninth day 35 parts of Start of Winter qi, it is not visible.
translations.idiomatic: For Mercury in evening swift motion from the start of Great Heat through day 9, part 35 of Start of Winter, it is invisible.

sentences.zh: 晨留，在大寒氣初日至立夏氣九日三十五分以下者，春不晨見，秋不夕見者，亦舊有之矣。

translations.literal: When in morning station from the start of Great Cold qi through the ninth day 35 parts of Start of Summer qi, in spring it is not seen at dawn and in autumn not at dusk—this too was known of old.
translations.idiomatic: When in morning station from the start of Great Cold through day 9, part 35 of Start of Summer, it is not seen at dawn in spring or at dusk in autumn—an old observation as well.

sentences.zh: 古之言天者有三家：一曰蓋天，二曰宣夜，三曰渾天。

translations.literal: Among ancients who spoke of Heaven there were three schools: first, Canopy Heaven; second, Overnight Heaven; third, Spherical Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Ancient theorists of Heaven recognized three schools: Canopy Heaven, Overnight Heaven, and Spherical Heaven.

sentences.zh: 漢靈帝時，蔡邕于朔方上書，言「宣夜之學，絕無師法」；

translations.literal: In Emperor Ling of Han's time, Cai Yong submitted a memorial from Shuofang saying, "The Overnight Heaven school has absolutely no transmitted teaching lineage";
translations.idiomatic: Under Emperor Ling of Han, Cai Yong wrote from Shuofang that "the Overnight Heaven school has no surviving master lineage";

sentences.zh: 《周髀》術數具存，考驗天狀，多所違失；

translations.literal: "the Zhou Gnomon calculations survive in full, yet when tested against Heaven's condition they miss widely";
translations.idiomatic: "the Zhou Gnomon methods are fully preserved, yet testing them against the sky shows wide error";

sentences.zh: 惟有渾天為近，最得其情，近世太史候台銅儀是也。

translations.literal: "only Spherical Heaven comes nearest and best matches the facts—the recent-age Imperial Astronomer observation-platform bronze instrument is an instance."
translations.idiomatic: "only Spherical Heaven comes closest to the truth—the recent Imperial Astronomer's bronze observation-platform instrument is the example."

sentences.zh: 立八心體圓而具天地之形，以正黃道赤道之表裏，以行日月之度數，步五緯之遲速，察氣候之推遷，精微深妙，百代所不可廢者也。

translations.literal: It sets up eight pivot-tiers in a round body complete with Heaven-and-Earth's form, to rectify the inner and outer of the ecliptic and equator, to carry sun and moon's degree-numbers, to pace the five conductors' slowness and speed, and to observe qi and seasonal shift—subtle, profound, and exquisite, what no generation may discard.
translations.idiomatic: It mounts eight pivot-tiers in a round body embodying Heaven and Earth, fixes the ecliptic and equator inside and out, carries the sun and moon through their degrees, paces the five planets' motion, and tracks seasonal change—subtle and indispensable for every age.

sentences.zh: 然傳曆久遠，製造者眾，測候占察，互有得失，張衡之制，謂之《靈憲》，史失其傳。

translations.literal: Yet transmission has been long and makers many; in measurement, observation, and divination each had gains and losses. Zhang Heng's design, called the Ling Xian, was lost from the historical record.
translations.idiomatic: Yet over long transmission many makers differed in measurement, observation, and prognostication. Zhang Heng's design, the Ling Xian, was lost from the histories.

sentences.zh: 魏、晉以來，官有其器，而無本書，故前志亦闕。

translations.literal: From Wei and Jin onward the court had the instrument but not the original book, so the former monograph also omits it.
translations.idiomatic: From Wei and Jin on the court kept the instrument without the original text, so earlier bibliographies omit it as well.

sentences.zh: 吳中常侍王蕃雲：「渾天儀者，羲和之舊器，謂之機衡。

translations.literal: Wu Palace Attendant Wang Fan said: "The spherical armillary is the old instrument of Xihe, called the Mechanism and Balance.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Fan, Palace Attendant of Wu, wrote: "The spherical armillary is Xihe's ancient instrument, called the Mechanism and Balance.

sentences.zh: 」積代相傳，沿革不一。

translations.literal: " Passed down through successive generations, its modifications are not uniform."
translations.idiomatic: " Handed down through generations, its forms have varied without end."

sentences.zh: 宋太平興國中，蜀人張思訓首創其式，造之禁中，逾年而成，詔置文明殿東鼓樓下，曰「太平渾儀」。

translations.literal: In Song's Taiping Xingguo, the Shu man Zhang Sixun first devised its form, built it within the palace precincts; after more than a year it was completed, and by edict it was placed beneath the east drum tower of the Hall of Cultured Brilliance, titled "Taiping Armillary Instrument."
translations.idiomatic: During Song Taiping Xingguo, the Shu artisan Zhang Sixun first devised the design and built it in the inner palace; after more than a year it was finished, and by edict it was installed beneath the east drum tower of the Hall of Cultured Brilliance as the "Taiping Armillary Instrument."

sentences.zh: 自思訓死，璣衡斷壞，無複知其法制者。

translations.literal: After Sixun died, the celestial regulator was broken, and none again knew its methods of construction.
translations.idiomatic: When Sixun died, the armillary regulator lay broken, and no one again knew how it had been made.

sentences.zh: 景德中，曆官韓顯符依仿劉曜時、孔挺、晁崇之法，失之簡略。

translations.literal: In Jingde, calendar officer Han Xianfu followed the methods of Liu Yao's time, Kong Ting, and Chao Chong—too spare.
translations.idiomatic: In Jingde, calendar officer Han Xianfu followed the methods of Liu Yao's day, Kong Ting, and Chao Chong, but the result was too spare.

sentences.zh: 景祐中，冬官正舒易簡乃用唐梁令瓚、僧一行之法，頗為詳備，亦失之於密而難為用。

translations.literal: In Jingyou, Director of the Winter Office Shu Yijian applied the Tang methods of Liang Lingzan and the monk Yixing—quite full, yet too dense to use.
translations.idiomatic: In Jingyou, Director of the Winter Office Shu Yijian used the Tang methods of Liang Lingzan and the monk Yixing; though detailed, it was too intricate for practical use.

sentences.zh: 元祐時，尚書右丞蘇頌與昭文館校理沈括奉敕詳定《渾儀法要》，遂奏舉吏部勾當官韓公廉通《九章勾股法》，常以推考天度與張衡、王蕃、僧一行、梁令瓚、張思訓法式，大綱可以尋究。

translations.literal: In the Yuanyou era, Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs Su Song and collator of the Hall for the Veneration of Literature Shen Kuo received orders to fix the Essentials of the Armillary Instrument in detail, then memorialized recommending Ministry clerk Han Gonglian, who knew the Nine Chapters' right-triangle methods and often reckoned celestial degrees against the formulas of Zhang Heng, Wang Fan, the monk Yixing, Liang Lingzan, and Zhang Sixun—the main outlines could be pursued.
translations.idiomatic: In Yuanyou, Vice Director Su Song and Hall collator Shen Kuo were ordered to fix the Essentials of the Armillary Instrument; they then recommended Ministry clerk Han Gonglian, versed in the Nine Chapters' right-triangle methods, who had long compared celestial degrees with the formulas of Zhang Heng, Wang Fan, Yixing, Liang Lingzan, and Zhang Sixun and could master the main outlines.

sentences.zh: 若據算術考案象器，亦能成就，請置局差官製造。

translations.literal: If by arithmetic the instrument be examined, it too can be completed—request establishment of a bureau to assign officials for manufacture.
translations.idiomatic: By arithmetic the instrument could be verified and completed; they asked that a bureau be set up to assign officials to build it.

sentences.zh: 詔如所言。

translations.literal: An edict followed his words.
translations.idiomatic: The throne approved as proposed.

sentences.zh: 奏鄭州原武主簿王沇之，太史局官周日嚴、于太古、張促宣，同行監造。

translations.literal: They memorialized Zhengzhou Yuanwu chief clerk Wang Yanzhi, and Astronomy Bureau officers Zhou Riyan, Yu Taigu, and Zhang Cuxuan to supervise manufacture together.
translations.idiomatic: They named Zhengzhou Yuanwu chief clerk Wang Yanzhi and Astronomy Bureau officers Zhou Riyan, Yu Taigu, and Zhang Cuxuan to supervise the work together.

sentences.zh: 制度既成，詔置之集英殿，總謂之渾天儀。

translations.literal: When the system was complete, by edict it was placed in the Hall for Assembling Excellence; collectively it was called the Armillary Sphere.
translations.idiomatic: When the mechanism was finished, an edict placed it in the Hall for Assembling Excellence; the whole was called the Armillary Sphere.

sentences.zh: 公廉交造儀時，先撰《九章勾股驗測渾天書》一卷，貯之禁中，今失其傳，故世無知者。

translations.literal: When Gonglian undertook the instrument, he first drafted one fascicle of Verification of the Armillary Sphere by the Nine Chapters' Right Triangles and stored it in the inner palace; it is now lost, so the world knows nothing of it.
translations.idiomatic: While building the instrument, Gonglian first wrote a fascicle on verifying the armillary sphere with Nine Chapters right-triangle methods and lodged it in the inner palace; that text is now lost, so the world no longer knows his methods.

sentences.zh: 舊制渾儀，規天矩地，機隱於內，上布經躔，次具日月五星行度，以察其寒暑進退，如張衡渾天、開元水運銅渾儀者，是也。

translations.literal: The old armillary instrument squared heaven and rectified earth, its mechanism hidden within, with the celestial paths arrayed above and sun, moon, and five planets' motions set forth to observe cold and heat advancing and retreating—as in Zhang Heng's armillary heaven and the Kaiyuan water-driven bronze armillary—such was it.
translations.idiomatic: The old armillary squared heaven and rectified earth, mechanisms hidden within, with celestial paths above and the sun, moon, and five planets' courses set out to read cold and heat—like Zhang Heng's armillary heaven or the Kaiyuan water-driven bronze armillary.

sentences.zh: 久而不合，乖於施用。

translations.literal: Kept long, it no longer matched; it failed in use.
translations.idiomatic: Kept long, it fell out of alignment and proved hard to use.

sentences.zh: 公廉之制則為輪三重：一曰六合儀，縱置地渾中，即天經環也，與地渾相結，其體不動；

translations.literal: Gonglian's design used three wheels: first, the Six Harmonies Instrument, set upright within the Earth Sphere—that is the heaven-meridian ring, joined to the Earth Sphere, its body unmoving;
translations.idiomatic: Gonglian's design used three nested wheels: first, the Six Harmonies Instrument, set upright within the Earth Sphere—the heaven-meridian ring joined to the Earth Sphere, its frame fixed;

sentences.zh: 二曰三辰儀，置六合儀內；

translations.literal: second, the Three Chronograms Instrument, set within the Six Harmonies Instrument;
translations.idiomatic: second, the Three Chronograms Instrument within the Six Harmonies Instrument;

sentences.zh: 三曰四遊儀，置三辰儀內。

translations.literal: third, the Four Paces Instrument, set within the Three Chronograms Instrument.
translations.idiomatic: third, the Four Paces Instrument within the Three Chronograms Instrument.

sentences.zh: 植四龍柱於地渾之下，又置鰲雲於六合儀下。

translations.literal: Four dragon pillars were planted beneath the Earth Sphere, and a turtle-and-cloud stand was set beneath the Six Harmonies Instrument.
translations.idiomatic: Four dragon pillars stood beneath the Earth Sphere, with a turtle-and-cloud pedestal under the Six Harmonies Instrument.

sentences.zh: 四龍柱下設十字水趺，鑿溝道通水以平高下。

translations.literal: Beneath the four dragon pillars a cross-shaped water trough was set, channels cut to conduct water and level height and depth.
translations.idiomatic: Below the pillars a cross-shaped water trough was cut with channels to level the instrument.

sentences.zh: 別設天常單環於六合儀內，又設黃道赤道二單環，皆置三辰儀內，東西相交，隨天運轉，以驗列舍之行。

translations.literal: A separate celestial constant single ring was set within the Six Harmonies Instrument, and yellow-path and red-path single rings were also set within the Three Chronograms Instrument; they crossed east and west, turning with heaven's motion to verify the lodges' passage.
translations.idiomatic: Within the Six Harmonies Instrument he added a celestial constant ring; within the Three Chronograms Instrument he set yellow-path and red-path rings that crossed east and west and turned with heaven to verify the lodges' motion.

sentences.zh: 又為四象環，附三辰儀，相結於天運環，黃赤道兩交為直距二縱置於四遊儀內。

translations.literal: He also made a Four Images ring attached to the Three Chronograms Instrument, linked to the heaven-motion ring; the yellow and red paths' two crossings formed vertical distances set within the Four Paces Instrument.
translations.idiomatic: He also made a Four Images ring on the Three Chronograms Instrument, linked to the heaven-motion ring, with the yellow and red crossings as vertical distances inside the Four Paces Instrument.

sentences.zh: 北屬六合儀地渾之上，以正北極出地之度。

translations.literal: To the north it joined the Six Harmonies Instrument above the Earth Sphere to fix the pole star's degrees above earth.
translations.idiomatic: To the north it joined the Six Harmonies Instrument above the Earth Sphere to fix how far the north pole rises above the ground.

sentences.zh: 南屬六合儀地渾之下，以正南極入地之度。

translations.literal: To the south it joined the Six Harmonies Instrument below the Earth Sphere to fix the south pole's degrees entering earth.
translations.idiomatic: To the south it joined the instrument below the Earth Sphere to fix how far the south pole sinks below the ground.

sentences.zh: 此屬儀之大形也。

translations.literal: This is the instrument's great form.
translations.idiomatic: Such was the instrument's overall form.

sentences.zh: 直距內夾軒望筒一，於筒之半設關軸，附直距上，使運轉低昂，筒常指日，日體常在筒竅中，天西行一周，日東移一度，仍以窺測四方星度，皆斟酌李淳風、孔挺、韓顯符、舒易簡之制也。

translations.literal: Within the vertical distances a sighting tube was clamped; at the tube's midpoint a pivot axle was set, attached to the vertical distances so it could turn up and down; the tube always pointed at the sun, the sun's body always within the tube's aperture—as heaven turned west one circuit, the sun moved east one degree—still used to sight the four directions' star degrees; all drew on the designs of Li Chunfeng, Kong Ting, Han Xianfu, and Shu Yijian.
translations.idiomatic: Between the vertical distances he clamped a sighting tube with a pivot at its midpoint on the vertical arm so it could tilt; the tube always aimed at the sun within its aperture—as heaven wheeled west once, the sun shifted east one degree—and still served to sight stars in every quarter, drawing on Li Chunfeng, Kong Ting, Han Xianfu, and Shu Yijian.

sentences.zh: 三辰儀上設天運環，以水運之。

translations.literal: On the Three Chronograms Instrument he set a heaven-motion ring, driven by water.
translations.idiomatic: On the Three Chronograms Instrument he mounted a heaven-motion ring powered by water.

sentences.zh: 水運之法始于漢張衡，成于唐梁令瓚及僧一行，複于太平興國中張思訓，公廉今又變正其制，設天運環，下以天柱關軸之類上動渾儀，此新制也。

translations.literal: The water-drive method began with Han Zhang Heng, was perfected under Tang Liang Lingzan and the monk Yixing, revived in Taiping Xingguo by Zhang Sixun; Gonglian now revised it again, setting a heaven-motion ring whose pillar pivots below drove the armillary instrument—this was the new design.
translations.idiomatic: Water drive began with Zhang Heng, was perfected under Liang Lingzan and Yixing, revived by Zhang Sixun in Taiping Xingguo; Gonglian now revised it again, using a heaven-motion ring and pillar pivots below to move the armillary—a new design.

sentences.zh: 舊制渾象，張衡所謂置密室中者，推步七曜之運，以度曆象昏明之候，校二十四氣，考晝夜刻漏，無出於渾象。

translations.literal: The old celestial globe—what Zhang Heng called placing in a sealed chamber—steps the seven luminaries' motion to gauge the calendar's signs of dusk and dawn, checks the twenty-four qi, and tests day and night clepsydra marks; nothing surpasses the celestial globe.
translations.idiomatic: The old celestial globe—what Zhang Heng meant by housing in a sealed chamber—traces the seven luminaries to read dusk and dawn, checks the twenty-four qi, and tests day-and-night clepsydra marks; nothing surpasses it.

sentences.zh: 《隋志》稱梁秘府中有宋元嘉中所造者，以木為之，其圓如丸，遍體布二十八宿、三家星色、黃赤道、天河等，別為橫規繞於外，上下半之，以象地也。

translations.literal: The Sui Treatises say the Liang secretariat had one made in the Yuanjia era of Song, of wood, round as a ball, the whole body set with the twenty-eight lodges, the three schools' star colors, yellow and red paths, and the River of Heaven; a separate transverse ring wrapped outside, halved above and below, to represent earth.
translations.idiomatic: The Sui Treatises record that the Liang secretariat held a Yuanjia-era globe of wood, round as a ball, covered with the twenty-eight lodges, the three schools' star colors, yellow and red paths, and the River of Heaven, with a transverse ring halving it above and below to stand for earth.

sentences.zh: 開元中，詔僧一行與梁令瓚更造銅渾象，為圓天之象，上具列宿周天度數，注水激輪，令其自轉，一日一夜天轉一周，又別置日月五星循繞，絡在天外，令得運行。

translations.literal: In Kaiyuan, by edict the monk Yixing and Liang Lingzan remade a bronze celestial globe as the round heaven's image, bearing the lodges' degrees around heaven; water was poured to drive the wheel so it turned itself—one day and night heaven turned one circuit—and sun, moon, and five planets were set to circle outside heaven and run.
translations.idiomatic: In Kaiyuan, Yixing and Liang Lingzan were ordered to cast a bronze globe as the round sky, inscribed with every lodge's degree; poured water turned the wheel so that in one day and night heaven wheeled once, while sun, moon, and five planets were set to circle outside and run their courses.

sentences.zh: 每天西轉一匝，日正東行一度，月行一十三度有奇，凡二十九轉而日月會，三百六十五轉而日行一匝。

translations.literal: Each day heaven turned west one circuit, the sun moved due east one degree, the moon thirteen-odd degrees; after twenty-nine turns sun and moon met, and after three hundred sixty-five turns the sun completed one circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Each day heaven turned west once, the sun marched east one degree, the moon thirteen-odd degrees; after twenty-nine turns sun and moon met, and after three hundred sixty-five the sun finished a circuit.

sentences.zh: 仍置木櫃以為地平，令象半在地上，半在地下，又立二木偶人于地平之前，置鐘鼓使木人自然撞擊以報辰刻，命之曰《水運渾天俯視圖》。

translations.literal: A wooden cabinet was set as the level earth, so the globe stood half above ground and half below; two wooden figures were placed before the level earth, bells and drums set so the figures struck them of themselves to report the hours and marks, titled Diagram of the Water-Driven Armillary Heaven Viewed from Above.
translations.idiomatic: A wooden cabinet served as level earth so the globe stood half above and half below; two wooden men before it struck bells and drums by themselves to mark the hours, and the work was titled Diagram of the Water-Driven Armillary Heaven Viewed from Above.

sentences.zh: 既成，命置之武成殿。

translations.literal: When it was done, by edict it was placed in the Hall of Martial Accomplishment.
translations.idiomatic: When finished, an edict placed it in the Hall of Martial Accomplishment.

sentences.zh: 宋太史局舊無渾象，太平興國中，張思訓准開元之法，而上以蓋為紫宮，旁為周天度，而東西轉之，出新意也。

translations.literal: The Song Astronomy Bureau had no celestial globe; in Taiping Xingguo Zhang Sixun followed the Kaiyuan method but set a canopy as the Purple Palace above and the circuit of heaven beside it, turning east and west—a new idea.
translations.idiomatic: The Song Astronomy Bureau had no globe until Taiping Xingguo, when Zhang Sixun followed Kaiyuan practice but capped it with the Purple Palace and set the circuit of heaven beside it to turn east and west—a fresh design.

sentences.zh: 公廉乃增損《隋志》制之，上列二十八宿周天度數，及紫微垣中外官星，以俯窺七政之運轉，納於六合儀天經地渾之內，同以木櫃載之。

translations.literal: Gonglian then enlarged and reduced the Sui Treatises' design, setting above the twenty-eight lodges' degrees around heaven and the Purple Forbidden Enclosure's inner and outer stars, to look down on the seven regulators' motion, housed within the Six Harmonies Instrument's heaven meridian and Earth Sphere, all carried on the same wooden cabinet.
translations.idiomatic: Gonglian then revised the Sui Treatises' globe, inscribing the twenty-eight lodges' degrees and the Purple Forbidden Enclosure's inner and outer stars to watch the seven regulators from above, nested within the Six Harmonies Instrument's heaven meridian and Earth Sphere on the same wooden cabinet.

sentences.zh: 其中貫以樞軸，南北出渾象外，南長北短，地渾在木櫃面，橫置之，以象地。

translations.literal: A pivot shaft ran through it, north and south projecting outside the globe—longer south, shorter north; the Earth Sphere lay on the cabinet face, set crosswise to represent earth.
translations.idiomatic: A pivot ran through it, projecting north and south beyond the globe—longer to the south, shorter to the north; the Earth Sphere lay on the cabinet, cross-mounted as earth.

sentences.zh: 天經與地渾相結，縱置之，半在地上，半隱地下，以象天。

translations.literal: The heaven meridian joined the Earth Sphere, set lengthwise, half above ground and half hidden below, to represent heaven.
translations.idiomatic: The heaven meridian joined the Earth Sphere upright, half above ground and half below, to represent heaven.

sentences.zh: 其樞軸北貫天經上杠中，末與杠平，出櫃外三十五度稍弱，以象北極出地。

translations.literal: The pivot's north end pierced the heaven meridian's upper frame at center, its tip level with the frame, projecting thirty-five and a fraction degrees outside the cabinet to show the north pole above earth.
translations.idiomatic: The pivot's north end pierced the upper frame of the heaven meridian, flush with the frame, and projected thirty-five-odd degrees beyond the cabinet as the north pole above earth.

sentences.zh: 南亦貫天經出下杠外，入櫃內三十五度少弱，以象南極入地。

translations.literal: The south end also pierced the heaven meridian below the lower frame, entering the cabinet thirty-five and a fraction degrees short of level, to show the south pole below earth.
translations.idiomatic: The south end pierced below the lower frame into the cabinet thirty-five-odd degrees shy of level, showing the south pole below earth.

sentences.zh: 就赤道為牙距，四百七十八牙以銜天輪，隨機輪地轂正東西運轉，昏明中星既應其度，分至節氣亦驗應而不差。

translations.literal: At the red path he made cog teeth, four hundred seventy-eight teeth to mesh the heaven wheel; as the mechanism wheel and earth hub turned due east and west, dusk, dawn, and culminating stars answered their degrees, and solstices and qi verified without error.
translations.idiomatic: At the red path he cut four hundred seventy-eight cog teeth to mesh the heaven wheel; as the drive wheel and earth hub turned east and west, dusk, dawn, and culminating stars matched their degrees and solstices and qi checked true.

sentences.zh: 王蕃雲：「渾象之法，地當在天內，其勢不便，故反觀其形，地為外郭，于已解者無異，詭狀殊體而合於理，可謂奇巧者也。

translations.literal: Wang Fan said: "In the celestial globe's method, earth ought to lie within heaven—an awkward arrangement—so the form is reversed: earth becomes the outer shell; for those who grasp it there is no difference, yet the strange shape and special body accord with reason—one may call it ingeniously wrought."
translations.idiomatic: Wang Fan wrote: "By the globe's logic earth should lie inside heaven, which is awkward, so the form is reversed with earth as the outer shell; for those who understand, nothing changes—it is a strange body yet sound in principle, and may be called ingenious."

sentences.zh: 」今地渾說在渾象外，蓋出於王蕃制也。

translations.literal: Now the Earth Sphere lies outside the globe—this comes from Wang Fan's design.
translations.idiomatic: Today the Earth Sphere stands outside the globe, following Wang Fan's design.

sentences.zh: 其下則思訓舊制，有樞輪關軸，激水運動，以直神搖鈴扣鐘擊鼓，置時刻十二神司辰像於輪上，時初、正至，則執牌迴圈而出，報隨刻數以定晝夜長短。

translations.literal: Below that was Sixun's old design, with pivot wheels and axle pivots, water driving motion, a spirit rocking bells and striking drums; twelve hour-gods in charge of the marks were set on the wheel, and at the first and proper marks of each hour they turned out plaques reporting the clepsydra count to fix day and night length.
translations.idiomatic: Below stood Sixun's older mechanism: pivot wheels and axles, water drive, spirits rocking bells and beating drums, twelve hour-gods on the wheel who at each hour's first and proper marks turned out plaques to report the clepsydra count and fix day and night length.

sentences.zh: 至冬水凝，運轉遲澀，則以水銀代之。

translations.literal: When winter water froze and motion grew sluggish, mercury was used instead.
translations.idiomatic: When winter froze the water and the works slowed, mercury replaced it.

sentences.zh: 今公廉所制，共置一台，台中有二隔，渾儀置其上，渾象置其中，激水運轉，樞機輪軸隱於下。

translations.literal: What Gonglian made was set on one platform; within the platform were two compartments—the armillary instrument above, the celestial globe within—water driving the turn, pivot wheels and axles hidden below.
translations.idiomatic: Gonglian built one platform with two compartments: the armillary instrument above, the celestial globe within, water driving the motion while wheels and axles lay hidden below.

sentences.zh: 內設晝夜時刻機輪五重；

translations.literal: Within were five wheels for day, night, hours, and marks;
translations.idiomatic: Inside ran five wheels for day, night, hours, and marks:

sentences.zh: 第一重曰天輪，以撥渾象赤道牙距；

translations.literal: the first called the heaven wheel, to mesh with the globe's red-path cog teeth;
translations.idiomatic: first, the heaven wheel, meshing with the globe's red-path cogs;

sentences.zh: 第二重曰撥牙輪，上安牙距，隨天柱中輪轉動，以運上下四輪；

translations.literal: the second called the tooth-engaging wheel, with cog teeth above, turning with the central pillar wheel to drive the four wheels above and below;
translations.idiomatic: second, the tooth-engaging wheel, cogged above, turning with the central pillar wheel to drive four wheels;

sentences.zh: 第三重曰時刻鐘鼓輪，上安時初、時正百刻撥牙，以扣鐘擊鼓搖鈴；

translations.literal: the third called the hour-and-mark bell-and-drum wheel, bearing the first- and proper-hour hundred-mark teeth to strike bells, beat drums, and ring chimes;
translations.idiomatic: third, the hour-and-mark bell-and-drum wheel, with teeth for each hour's first and proper marks and the hundred marks to ring bells and drums;

sentences.zh: 第四重曰日時初正司辰輪，上安時初十二司辰、時正十二司辰；

translations.literal: the fourth called the first- and proper-hour mark-keeping wheel, bearing twelve mark-keepers for the first hour and twelve for the proper hour;
translations.idiomatic: fourth, the first- and proper-hour mark-keeping wheel, with twelve keepers for the first hour and twelve for the proper hour;

sentences.zh: 第五重曰報刻司辰輪，上安百刻司辰。

translations.literal: the fifth called the mark-reporting mark-keeping wheel, bearing the hundred-mark keepers.
translations.idiomatic: fifth, the mark-reporting wheel, bearing the hundred-mark keepers.

sentences.zh: 以上五輪並貫於一軸，上以天束束之，下以鐵杵臼承之，前以木閣五層蔽之，稍增異其舊制矣。

translations.literal: The five wheels were all threaded on one axle, bound above by a heaven brace and borne below by an iron mortar and pestle, fronted by a five-tier wooden cabinet that hid them—somewhat altered from the old design.
translations.idiomatic: All five wheels shared one axle, braced above and borne on an iron socket below, screened by a five-tier wooden cabinet—a modest change from older practice.

sentences.zh: 五輪之北，又側設樞輪，其輪以七十二輻為三十六洪，束以三輞，夾持受水三十六壺。

translations.literal: North of the five wheels a side pivot wheel was set; its wheel used seventy-two spokes as thirty-six troughs, bound by three rims, holding thirty-six water jars.
translations.idiomatic: North of the five wheels he added a side pivot wheel of seventy-two spokes forming thirty-six troughs in three rims, holding thirty-six water jars.

sentences.zh: 轂中橫貫鐵樞軸一，南北出軸為地轂，運撥地輪。

translations.literal: An iron pivot axle ran crosswise through the hub; north and south it projected as the earth hub to drive the earth wheel.
translations.idiomatic: An iron axle crossed the hub, projecting north and south as the earth hub to drive the earth wheel.

sentences.zh: 天柱中輪動，機輪動渾象，上動渾天儀。

translations.literal: When the central pillar wheel moved, the mechanism wheel moved the globe, and above moved the armillary heaven instrument.
translations.idiomatic: When the central pillar wheel turned, the mechanism wheel turned the globe and, above, the armillary instrument.

sentences.zh: 又樞輪左設天池、平水壺，平水壺受天池水，注入受水壺，以激樞輪。

translations.literal: Left of the pivot wheel were set a heaven pool and level-water jar; the level-water jar received heaven-pool water and poured it into the receiving jar to drive the pivot wheel.
translations.idiomatic: To the pivot wheel's left stood a heaven pool and level-water jar; the level-water jar took heaven-pool water and fed the receiving jar to drive the pivot wheel.

sentences.zh: 受水壺落入退水壺。

translations.literal: The receiving jar drained into the return-water jar.
translations.idiomatic: From the receiving jar water fell into the return-water jar.

sentences.zh: 由壺下北竅引水入升水下壺，以升水下輪運水入升水上壺，上壺內升水上輪及河車同轉上下輪，運水入天河，天河複流入天地，每一晝一夜周而復始。

translations.literal: Through a north opening below the jar water was drawn into the lower lift-water jar; the lower lift-water wheel raised water into the upper lift-water jar, and within the upper jar the upper lift-water wheel and river carriage turned together, lifting water into the River of Heaven; the River of Heaven flowed back into heaven and earth, cycling every day and night.
translations.idiomatic: A north vent drew water into the lower lift jar; the lower lift wheel raised it to the upper jar, where upper lift wheel and river carriage turned together and poured into the River of Heaven, which returned to heaven and earth and cycled every day and night.

sentences.zh: 此公廉制渾儀、渾象二器而通三用，總而名之曰渾天儀。

translations.literal: Thus Gonglian's armillary instrument and celestial globe, two instruments serving three uses, were collectively named the Armillary Sphere.
translations.idiomatic: Thus Gonglian's armillary instrument and globe—two bodies, three uses—were together called the Armillary Sphere.

sentences.zh: 金既取汴，皆輦致于燕，天輪赤道牙距撥輪懸象鐘鼓司辰刻報天池水壺等器久皆棄毀，惟銅渾儀置之太史局候台。

translations.literal: After Jin took Bian, all were carted to Yan; the heaven wheel's red-path cog teeth, drive wheel, suspended globe, bells, drums, mark-keepers, clepsydra reporting, heaven pool, and water jars were long abandoned and ruined—only the bronze armillary instrument was kept at the Astronomy Bureau observation terrace.
translations.idiomatic: When Jin seized Bian, everything was hauled to Yan; heaven wheel, red-path cogs, drive wheel, suspended globe, bells, drums, mark-keepers, clepsydra works, heaven pool, and water jars were long ruined—only the bronze armillary was kept on the Astronomy Bureau terrace.

sentences.zh: 但自汴至燕相去一千餘裏，地勢高下不同，望筒中取極星稍差，移下四度才得窺之。

translations.literal: But from Bian to Yan was more than a thousand li, and the land's height and depth differed; through the sighting tube the pole star was slightly off, and it had to be lowered four degrees before it could be sighted.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Bian and Yan lay more than a thousand li apart with different terrain; through the sighting tube the pole star sat slightly awry, and the tube had to be lowered four degrees before it could be aimed.

sentences.zh: 明昌六年秋八月，風雨大作，雷電震擊，龍起渾儀鰲雲水趺下，台忽中裂而摧，渾儀僕落台下，旋命有司營葺之，複置臺上。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn in the sixth year of Mingchang, great wind and rain arose, thunder and lightning struck, dragons rose from the armillary instrument's turtle-and-cloud and water trough below, the platform suddenly split and collapsed, the armillary instrument fell below the terrace, and at once officials were ordered to repair it and set it on the terrace again.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, eighth month, sixth year of Mingchang, a storm broke with thunder; dragons seemed to rise from the instrument's turtle-and-cloud and trough, the platform split and fell, and the armillary toppled; officials were ordered to repair it and restore it to the terrace.

sentences.zh: 貞祐南渡，以渾儀熔鑄成物，不忍毀拆，若全體以運則艱於輦載，遂委而去。

translations.literal: At the Zhenyou southern crossing, the armillary instrument was cast into objects—unwilling to destroy it whole—yet to run it entire made cartage hard, so it was abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: At the Zhenyou flight south, the armillary was melted down for metal rather than dismantled, yet moving it whole was too hard, so it was left behind.

sentences.zh: 興定中，司天臺官以台中不置渾儀及測候人數不足，言之於朝，宜鑄儀象，多補生員，庶得盡占考之實。

translations.literal: In Xingding, Astronomy Bureau officers, because the terrace held no armillary instrument and observers were too few, spoke to the court that instruments and images should be cast and students added, so that observation and reckoning might be fully real.
translations.idiomatic: In Xingding, bureau officers told the court that with no armillary on the terrace and too few observers, new instruments should be cast and trainees added so observation could be real again.

sentences.zh: 宣宗召禮部尚書楊雲翼問之，雲翼對曰：「國家自來銅禁甚嚴，雖罄公私所有，恐不能給。

translations.literal: Emperor Xuanzong summoned Minister of Rites Yang Yunyi to ask; Yunyi replied: "Since the founding, copper has been strictly forbidden; even if public and private stocks were emptied, it might not suffice.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xuanzong asked Minister of Rites Yang Yunyi, who answered: "Since the founding copper has been tightly barred; even draining public and private stores might not suffice.

sentences.zh: 今調度方殷，財用不足，實未可行。

translations.literal: Now schedules are pressing and funds short—it truly cannot be done."
translations.idiomatic: Schedules are tight and funds scarce; it truly cannot be done now."

sentences.zh: 」他日，上又言之，於是止添測候之人數員，鑄儀之議遂寢。

translations.literal: Another day the emperor spoke of it again; then only observer posts were added, and the plan to cast instruments was laid to rest.
translations.idiomatic: On another day the emperor raised it again; in the end only observer posts were added, and the casting plan died.

sentences.zh: 初，張行簡為禮部尚書提點司天監時，嘗制蓮花、星丸二漏以進，章宗命置蓮花漏二禁中，星丸漏遇車駕巡幸則用之。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Zhang Xingjian was Minister of Rites supervising the Astronomy Directorate, he had made lotus and star-pill clepsydras and presented them; Zhangzong ordered two lotus clepsydras placed in the inner palace, the star-pill clepsydra used when the imperial carriage toured.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, as Minister of Rites over the Astronomy Directorate, Zhang Xingjian devised lotus and star-pill clepsydras and presented them; Zhangzong kept two lotus clepsydras in the inner palace and used the star-pill clepsydra on imperial tours.

sentences.zh: 貞祐南渡，二漏皆遷於汴，汴亡廢毀，無所稽其制矣。

translations.literal: At the Zhenyou southern crossing both clepsydras were moved to Bian; when Bian fell they were ruined, and their design can no longer be traced.
translations.idiomatic: At the Zhenyou flight both were moved to Bian; when Bian fell they were destroyed, and their design is lost.
